description:
Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Schedule: Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST (Graveyard / Night Shift in PH)

Salary: $800 – $1,500 USD/month (Based on experience) + Performance Bonuses



About the Role

We are a fast-growing Canadian home services company (HVAC, Electrical, & EV Chargers) looking for a hyper-detail-oriented Operations & Customer Support Virtual Assistant to manage our daily administrative, permitting, and client communication workflows.



If you have hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), speak fluent English with a natural North American accent/tone, and thrive on keeping systems perfectly organized, this is a stable, long-term opportunity for you!



Key Responsibilities

Permit Management: Submit EV charger and service permit applications via online portals (following step-by-step video SOPs) and ensure prompt closure upon job completion.



CRM & Sales Pipeline (GoHighLevel): Filter daily inbound contacts, route genuine leads, update funnel stages, generate standard proposals, and execute 48-hour follow-ups.



Client Communication: Handle inbound/outbound phone calls, texts,
s, and web chats (rescheduling, invoice updates, deposit adjustments, and basic support).



Quality Control & Admin: Verify invoices, deposits, and client records to ensure zero revenue leakage. Assist with social media engagement and inbox cleanup during downtime.



Candidate Requirements (Non-Negotiables)

Fluent English: C2/Near-native spoken and written English with a neutral accent. Must be completely confident and natural on the phone with North American clients.



GoHighLevel Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience using GHL for CRM management, messaging, and sales pipelines.

Experience: 1–2+ years as a Virtual Assistant, Customer Service Rep, or Operations Assistant for a US or Canadian client (Trades/HVAC/Electrical experience is a huge plus).



Extreme Attention to Detail: High accuracy when managing numbers, invoices, and customer records.

Work Setup: Dedicated quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and backup power (UPS/generator) for graveyard shift availability (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST).



What We Offer

Competitive base pay ($800–$1,500/mo) with additional KPI-based performance bonuses.

Clear, pre-recorded video SOPs and supportive operational leadership.

Long-term stability in a essential home services industry.

2. Conducting daily product research and finding new products for us to test.



We are looking for someone who already has practical experience with advertising platforms. **We do not want to teach someone how to create campaigns, ad sets, or ads from scratch.**



## Advertising Tasks



You will work mainly with *
 Ads Manager and 
 Ads**.



All advertising materials will be prepared and provided by our team, including videos, images, ad copy, headlines, and landing page links.



Your job will simply be to correctly upload and launch them according to our instructions.



Typical tasks will include:



* Adding a new ad set to an existing campaign

* Adding new ads and creatives to existing ad sets

* Creating new campaigns using our predefined structure

* Launching a new campaign with 3 initial ad sets

* Adding additional ad sets and creatives in the following days as new materials are prepared by our video editor

* Checking that all ads, links, tracking settings, and campaign structures are set up correctly



Our campaign setup is standardized. New campaigns are launched using the same predefined starting budgets and structures, so you will not need to make decisions about budgets or campaign strategy.



**Campaign optimization is handled by another person on our team.**



You will NOT be responsible for:



* Optimizing campaigns

* Scaling or reducing budgets

* Analyzing campaign performance

* D
 which ads should be turned off

* Developing advertising strategies



However, you must already understand how
 Ads Manager works and be able to independently create campaigns, ad sets, and ads.



Experience with Taboola Ads is a strong advantage. If you already understand the basics of native advertising platforms, the work will be straightforward.



## Daily Product Research



The second part of your role will be conducting daily product research.



We will provide you with access to the research tool we use and explain our criteria for selecting products.



Your responsibility will be to:



* Research new e-commerce products every day

* Analyze products currently being advertised and sold online

* Identify products that match our criteria

* Find **3 promising products per day**

* Add all selected products to our shared Excel/Google Sheets file

* Include the required links and information for each product



You do not need to make the final decision about which products we launch. Your responsibility is to consistently find and organize potential products for our team to review.



## Requirements



You should:



* Have practical experience with
 Ads Manager

* Know how to create campaigns, ad sets, and ads without training

* Understand the basic structure of
 advertising campaigns

* Be able to follow predefined campaign structures and instructions

* Have experience uploading and launching ads using ready-made creatives

* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets such as Excel or Google Sheets

* Be able to conduct online product research

* Be organized and pay strong attention to detail

* Be able to work independently and complete daily tasks consistently



Experience with **Taboola Ads** and e-commerce product research is a strong advantage.



**We are not looking for a complete beginner.** You should already know how to work inside
 Ads Manager. We can explain our internal processes and campaign structures, but we do not want to teach the basics of launching advertisements.



## About the Work



We operate multiple e-commerce stores and regularly launch and test new products across different markets.



Your daily work will be structured and repetitive. You will receive ready-made advertising materials from our team, upload them according to our predefined system, and conduct daily product research.



The strategic side of advertising, campaign optimization, budget management, and scaling is handled by other members of our team.



We are looking for someone reliable, accurate, and consistent who wants to work with us **long-term**.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short description of your experience with
 Ads Manager

* Your experience with Taboola Ads, if any

* Your experience with e-commerce or product research

* How long you have been working with advertising platforms

* Your availability

* Your expected monthly salary



Please start your application with the word **"ADS"** so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Outbound Caller / Lead Qualifier - Life & Health Insurance (Remote)
description:
Outbound Caller / Lead Qualifier – Health Insurance (Remote, Philippines)



Pay: $5–$7 USD/hr depending on experience Schedule: Part-time or Full-time available | US business hours M-F | Setup: Remote / Work from home | Long-term for the right person



About the Role

We're a US-based health insurance team looking for an experienced outbound caller to contact prospects, ask qualifying profile questions, and pass qualified leads to our licensed agents. This is NOT a hard-sell or closing role — you're the first point of contact, gathering key information and setting the stage for our sales team.

You'll be given a script, a Q&A guide for common questions, and a list of leads. Your job is to work through them confidently, professionally, and efficiently. If you've done US-facing outbound campaigns before, you already know what this looks like.

What You'll Do

Make outbound calls to US-based prospects in the health insurance space

Follow a provided script while keeping conversations natural

Ask qualifying profile questions (age, household size, income range, zip code, etc.)

Pass qualified leads to licensed agents — you will NOT handle insurance-specific questions

Log call outcomes and lead details accurately in CRM (GoHighLevel experience is a plus)

Hit daily call volume and lead targets

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Minimum 1 year of experience on US-facing outbound call campaigns

Clear, confident English with a neutral or minimal accent

Comfortable making 80–150+ outbound calls per day

Reliable internet (minimum 10 Mbps) with a backup connection

Noise-canceling headset and a quiet workspace

Available to work US business hours (night shift PH time — exact schedule to be confirmed)

Self-starter who doesn't need daily hand-holding — you manage your time and hit your numbers

Nice to Have

Experience in health insurance, ACA, or Medicare campaigns

GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM experience

Previous appointment setting or lead qualification roles

Ultra Labs is a U.S.-based business incubator/accelerator that focuses on software/tech-based businesses. We are currently seeking a talented Senior Frontend Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge solutions across multiple complex business applications.



As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you’ll work on sophisticated enterprise applications including MSP management platforms, educational technology systems, and multi-tenant SaaS applications. This role requires both deep technical expertise and the ability to understand complex business domains.



Development Environment Requirements

Platform Preference (Important)

_Preferred: macOS or Linux developers

_Acceptable: Windows developers with demonstrated WSL2 proficiency

_We operate a BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) contractor model. Our team is primarily Mac/Linux-based, and our development workflows are optimized for Unix-like environments.



Required technical comfort:

_SSH configuration and key management (~/.ssh/config)

_SSH tunneling for secure development and database access

_Advanced Git workflows (rebasing, cherry-picking, complex merge strategies)

_Command-line proficiency and shell scripting

_Environment management across multiple projects



For Windows developers specifically:

_Active WSL2 usage (not just installed) with Ubuntu or similar

_Comfortable working between Windows and Linux environments

_Experience with cross-platform development challenges

_Ability to troubleshoot environment-specific issues independently



Technical Stack Overview

Primary Technologies

_React 17/18 with TypeScript and modern hooks patterns

_Redux Toolkit & RTK Query for state management and API integration

_Ant Design with Styled Components for UI development

_AWS Amplify for authentication and cloud services

_Complex build systems (CRACO, Webpack customization)



Integration Requirements

_AWS Services: Cognito, S3, CloudFront

_Payment Processing: Stripe integration

_Maps & Location: Google Maps API

_Third-party APIs: Various business service integrations

_Database connectivity: Multiple backend systems



Project Complexity Examples

_MSP Platform: 1,168+ TypeScript files, complex business workflows

_Educational Platform: Multi-application monorepo architecture

_Enterprise Features: Role-based access, multi-tenant architecture



Core Responsibilities

Frontend Architecture & Development

_Design and implement scalable React applications with TypeScript

_Build and maintain complex Redux state management systems

_Develop responsive, accessible user interfaces using Ant Design

_Optimize application performance for large datasets and real-time updates

_Collaborate with UX/UI designers to implement pixel-perfect, user-friendly interfaces



Integration & API Development

_Work closely with backend developers on Java and Python FastAPI applications

_Integrate frontend components with server-side logic across multiple tech stacks

_Implement secure authentication flows with AWS Cognito

_Build robust error handling and loading states for API interactions



Business Domain Implementation

_Translate complex business requirements into intuitive user interfaces

_Understand and implement domain-specific workflows (MSP, educational management)

_Build sophisticated forms, tables, and data visualization components

_Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimize for various devices



Code Quality & Collaboration

_Participate in code reviews and maintain high coding standards

_Write comprehensive unit and integration tests

_Document complex components and architectural decisions

_Mentor junior developers on React best practices and business domain knowledge



Required Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

_5+ years of React development experience with hooks, context, and advanced patterns

_Strong TypeScript proficiency - complex type definitions, generics, utility types

_Redux Toolkit expertise - RTK Query, async thunks, normalized state patterns

_Advanced JavaScript/ES6+ - modern language features and best practices

_CSS/Styling mastery - Styled Components, responsive design, CSS-in-JS



Essential Experience

_3+ years with complex business applications - B2B SaaS, enterprise software

_Component library development - reusable, composable architecture

_State management at scale - large applications, performance optimization

_API integration experience - RESTful APIs, error handling, caching

_Testing frameworks - Jest, React Testing Library, unit/integration testing



Development Environment

_Excellent spoken and written English

_Advanced Git proficiency - complex workflows, conflict resolution

_Build tools experience - Webpack, npm/yarn, modern toolchains

_Unix/Linux command line comfort (or WSL2 for Windows users)

_SSH and network configuration - tunnels, key management, config files



Collaboration & Process

_Agile/Scru
thodology experience

_Strong problem-solving skills and debugging abilities

_Excellent time management and ability to meet deadlines consistently

_Fast-paced environment adaptability

_Open to feedback and continuous learning mindset



Strongly Preferred (Polyglot Mindset)

Multi-Language Experience

We highly value polyglot programmers who demonstrate depth across multiple technologies:

_Backend awareness: Understanding of Java Spring Boot or Python FastAPI

_Scripting capabilities: Python for automation, data processing, or tooling

_Full-stack thinking: Ability to work across the entire application stack

_Technology adaptability: Track record of learning new languages/frameworks



Evidence we look for:

_GitHub/portfolio showing multiple programming languages

_Understanding of language-appropriate design patterns

_Ability to choose the right tool for each task

_Experience bridging frontend/backend communication effectively



Advanced Technical Preferences

_AWS ecosystem experience - Amplify, S3, Lambda, infrastructure knowledge

_Performance optimization - bundle analysis, runtime performance, memory management

_Accessibility expertise - WCAG compliance, screen reader support

_Testing strategy - E2E testing (Cypress), visual regression testing

_DevOps awareness - CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies



Domain Experience (Nice-to-Have)

_MSP/Service Desk knowledge - ticketing systems, time tracking, invoicing workflows

_Educational technology - registration systems, workshop management

_Multi-tenant architecture - organization-specific customization, role-based access

_Payment processing - Stripe integration, subscription management



Experience Level: Senior (5-7+ years)

_This role requires senior-level expertise due to:

_Codebase complexity - Large, interconnected applications with 1000+ components

_Architecture responsibilities - Making decisions that impact multiple applications

_Business domain complexity - Deep understanding of industry-specific workflows

_Integration challenges - Multiple third-party services and backend systems

_Performance requirements - Optimization for enterprise-scale usage



Success Metrics

Technical Delivery

_Ship complex features on schedule with minimal post-release bugs

_Maintain high code coverage and pass all automated quality checks

_Keep bundle sizes optimized and page load times under target thresholds

_Contribute to architectural decisions that improve long-term maintainability



Business Impact

_Deliver intuitive interfaces for complex business workflows

_Become proficient in domain-specific business processes and terminology

_Collaborate effectively with product managers and stakeholders

_Support the team’s ability to scale and take on larger projects



Team Contribution

_Mentor junior developers and contribute to knowledge sharing

_Participate actively in code reviews and architectural discussions

_Help establish and maintain development best practices

_Contribute to tooling and process improvements



What Makes This Role Unique

Technical Challenges:

_Work with multiple complex codebases simultaneously

_Balance performance, maintainability, and feature velocity

_Design applications that are inherently testable - clear component boundaries, predictable state management

_Implement comprehensive testing strategies - unit, integration, and E2E coverage for business-critical workflows

_Navigate the intersection of frontend excellence and business domain expertise

_Solve integration challenges across diverse technology stacks



Growth Opportunities:

_Gain expertise in multiple business domains (MSP, EdTech, SaaS)

_Work with cutting-edge React patterns and architectural approaches

_Influence technical decisions across multiple product teams

_Develop polyglot skills across our Java and Python backend systems



Impact:

_Your work directly enables business success for our portfolio companies

_Build systems that scale to serve thousands of users across multiple organizations

_Contribute to products that solve real-world business problems in growing industries

Please apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent via

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Operations and Accountability Lead
description:
If keeping people moving toward a goal is just "how you're wired", and watching 
ntum die HURTS you to your core - read on.



You're the person who can't leave a loop open.



When something was supposed to happen and didn't, you FEEL it.



Not because you need control - because incomplete action is genuinely uncomfortable to you.



You follow through - not because someone asked you to, but because it comes naturally to you.



You don't need to be the loudest person in the room. You don't need credit. You need COMPLETION.



The Work



Your job, put simply, is this -

Make sure the right things are happening at the right time.



Right now that means one defined project with a clear finish line. 



We're building a system from zero - setting it up, getting it running, and making sure it's documented and tested before it goes live. 



That's Phase One. 



Your job is to make sure it crosses the finish line completely and correctly.



After that, the work shifts to three ongoing modes:



First, you'll own the recurring pulse - ensuring pipeline, commitments, and follow-through are done on time and completely. Making sure nothing goes cold without a deliberate decision to let it go cold.



Then you'll help prioritize and delegate what comes up - the one-off tasks, the gaps that need closing along the way.



And you'll keep the system honest - making sure the people responsible for keeping it moving are actually keeping it moving.



You're not DOING the work. 



You're MAKING SURE the work GETS DONE.



You won't be on an island.



The answers, the context, the access - it's all there when you need it.



You only have to ask for it, use it to help build the systems we need, and make sure everyone is doing their part to keep that system moving.



The Offer



This is a small team with a proven offering.



It's made up of people that genuinely want to be held accountable.



That's not something you'll find everywhere.



You'll have real access, real permission, and a team that's actively asking for what you naturally do.



If you're the person we're describing, this isn't just "a job". It's the right fit for you.



Details



This starts as a defined project. If you execute it well, it becomes an ongoing role.



This is a full time position starting at $4/hour.



Some familiarity with CRM systems or marketing automation is helpful. If you have the character and a general familiarity with the skills, we'll train you on everything else.



Tools, systems, process - all of that can be learned.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED.



When the core project is complete, we'll find work that fits you. You won't be left idle.



To Apply



When you apply, tell us about a time something was ABOUT TO fall through the cracks and YOU were the reason it didn't.



In Closing



If you need to be managed, this isn't the right fit.



If you're the one who usually ends up doing the managing - even when it's not your job - and you'd love a role where that's exactly what's needed - let's talk.



'Cuz honestly, WE need to be managed.

title: Backend Engineer

Ultra Labs is a dynamic U.S.-based business incubator and accelerator focused on building and scaling innovative software and technology-driven businesses. title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead: Inventory Planning & Demand Forecasting (Amazon FBA)
description:
We run two complementary e-commerce Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across Amazon US, UK &.Canada, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships and procurement: purchase orders (POs): production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: replenishment timing, 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales (a lightweight S&OP rhythm), so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain or inventory management, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Hands-on purchasing experience with overseas manufacturers: raising POs, tracking production, reconciling deliveries

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400+/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000+), equivalent to $11 to $14+ per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Executive Virtual Assistant to support the founder of a growing veteran-owned startup. The business focuses on executive coaching, leadership development, higher education consulting, government opportunities, speaking, research, and writing.



The initial priority will be helping establish and grow an executive coaching practice. Approximately 50% of the VA’s time will focus on prospect research, outreach, follow-ups, CRM management, and appointment scheduling.



This role combines executive assistance, research, business development, marketing, and administrative support.







SHIFT

Monday to Thursday, 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time 



 

Job Duties and Responsibilities



1. Executive and Administrative Support

- Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, and follow-up tasks.

- Coordinate information exchanges, selection interviews, client meetings, and other business-development calls.

- Prepare meeting notes, action lists, simple reports, and organized reference materials.

- Maintain accurate records, contact lists, trackers, and shared files.

- Monitor deadlines and ensure agreed-upon next steps are completed.





2. Vistage Practice and Prospect Outreach

- Research and organize prospective executive-coaching candidates in the Baltimore market.

- Support weekly outreach to approximately 50–100 prospects, primarily through LinkedIn and text messaging, with
 and limited cold calling used when appropriate.

- Track outreach activity, responses, follow-ups, appointments, and pipeline status.

- Respond promptly to interested prospects and coordinate the next step in the Vistage process.

- Use and maintain Vistage’s white-label CRM/Chair App while following required security and access procedures.



3. Grant, Contract, and Funding Research

- Review designated local, state, federal, and grant databases several times per week.

- Identify opportunities aligned with leadership development, organizational development, consulting, and veteran-owned business capabilities.

- Summarize opportunity scope, eligibility, deadlines, and submission requirements.

- Maintain a clear funding-opportunity tracker and flag priority opportunities for review.

- Assist with grant and contract applications by compiling supporting information, organizing submission requirements, and coordinating with specialist grant-writing resources when needed.





4. Marketing and Digital Support

- Assist with outreach campaigns for coaching, consulting, speaking, research, and writing services.

- Create and update basic marketing materials in Canva using established brand guidelines.

- Support landing pages, lead-capture pages, marketing funnels, and campaign-related content.

- Update website content and help manage new website features as they are introduced.

- Support basic social media and LinkedIn activity, including content formatting, scheduling, and direct outreach.





5. Operations, Systems, and Growth Support

- Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows, outreach, scheduling, database research, and reporting.

title: Creative Marketing Designer & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
JOB TITLE



Creative Marketing Designer & Short-Form Video Editor



TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT



Part-Time



JOB DESCRIPTION



ABOUT THE PROJECT



We are launching a stress-reduction study and educational community designed primarily for people ages 18–24.



The study will teach and explore practical, evidence-informed stress-management methods, including controlled breathing techniques, physical tension-release exercises, and mental relaxation techniques. Some of these approaches are also used in military resilience and performance-training environments.



We need a highly creative designer and video editor who can turn these ideas into engaging, modern content that young adults will want to watch, understand, and share.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will develop the visual and creative side of the launch while the founder focuses on teaching.



You will transform raw teaching videos, ideas, research-informed concepts, and community updates into polished short-form videos, social content, graphics, presentations, and outreach materials.



This is not a basic Canva-assistant position. We want someone with excellent visual judgment, strong storytelling instincts, and the ability to create original work—not someone who relies on generic templates or unedited AI output.



WHAT YOU WILL CREATE



• Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and the community  

• Edited clips from longer teaching videos and interviews  

• Social-media graphics, carousels, announcements, and educational posts  

• Launch graphics, countdowns, calls to action, and participant-recruitment materials  

• Flyers and digital materials for fraternities, sororities, athletic groups, student organizations, and community partners  

• Sponsor presentations, partnership graphics, and simple pitch-deck visuals  

• Video thumbnails, titles, captions, and supporting graphics  

• Community banners, welcome materials, course covers, and resource graphics  

• Simple motion graphics, subtitles, transitions, and visual explanations  

• Creative variations for testing different messages and formats



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Help define a recognizable visual identity for the study and community  

• Turn raw founder recordings into concise, engaging videos  

• Identify strong 
nts, hooks, quotes, and teaching points within longer recordings  

• Create platform-appropriate formats and dimensions  

• Write or improve short captions, headlines, hooks, and calls to action  

• Organize creative files, drafts, revisions, and approved assets  

• Maintain a consistent voice and visual style  

• Build reusable templates without making every post look identical  

• Suggest creative campaign ideas instead of waiting for detailed instructions  

• Track which creative approaches perform best  

• Deliver reliable work according to an agreed content calendar



CREATIVE EXPECTATIONS



Your work should feel:



• Modern, energetic, approachable, and credible  

• Relevant to people ages 18–24  

• Calm and trustworthy without feeling clinical or boring  

• Visually distinctive rather than template-driven  

• Appropriate for an educational and research-informed initiative  

• Clear enough to explain stress-management ideas without exaggerating them



AI AND CREATIVE TOOLS



You may use AI tools for brainstorming, transcription, captioning, editing assistance, visual exploration, and workflow efficiency.



However:



• Every deliverable must be reviewed and refined by you  

• Generic, inaccurate, or obviously AI-generated work is not acceptable  

• AI-generated images must not misleadingly depict real study participants  

• Confidential participant information must never be entered into an unapproved AI system  

• Scientific or health-related claims must use approved language  

• Content must not imply military endorsement or promise medical results



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Strong portfolio of graphic-design and video-editing work  

• Excellent visual judgment, pacing, composition, typography, and attention to detail  

• Experience editing short-form social videos  

• Ability to create strong hooks and maintain viewer attention  

• Experience using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software  

• Ability to work from raw footage and limited direction  

• Strong written English and reliable communication  

• Ability to accept feedback and revise work efficiently  

• Organized file-management and naming practices  

• Reliable computer and internet connection



STRONGLY PREFERRED



• Experience creating content for people ages 18–24  

• Familiarity with university, athletic, fitness, wellness, educational, or youth-focused audiences  

• Experience marketing an online community, course, study, event, or membership  

• Ability to create light motion graphics or animated explanations  

• Experience designing sponsor decks and partnership materials  

• Experience repurposing one long video into several short pieces of content  

• Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and automated content workflows  

• Comfortable recommending creative strategy, not just executing tasks



SCHEDULE



Approximately 15 hours per week.



Most work may be completed on a flexible schedule. You must be available for two brief meetings each week scheduled sometime between 5:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.



The initial focus will be the community launch, with the possibility of ongoing work for the right person.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



• The project develops a clear and consistent visual identity  

• Raw teaching footage is turned into compelling content efficiently  

• Content is understandable, attractive, and appropriate for young adults  

• Deliverables are completed on schedule  

• Revisions decrease as you learn the project’s voice  

• Creative work supports participant recruitment, community engagement, and sponsor outreach  

• You consistently contribute useful creative ideas



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “CREATIVE STRESS STUDY.”



Then answer the following:



1. Share a link to your three strongest graphic-design samples.  

2. Share links to your three strongest short-form video samples.  

3. Identify the sample that best represents your personal creative style and explain why.  

4. Describe your role in producing each sample.  

5. What tools do you use for graphic design, video editing, motion graphics, and AI-assisted work?  

6. Describe how you would turn a 20-minute teaching video into a week of social content.  

7. What experience do you have creating content for people ages 18–24?  

8. What two meeting times can you consistently attend between 5:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time?  

9. How many short-form videos and graphics could you realistically produce in 15 hours per week?  

10. Confirm that you are willing to complete a small paid creative test if shortlisted.



Portfolio quality matters more than formal education. Applications without relevant design and video samples will not be considered.



WAGE/SALARY



$600–$900 USD per month, depending on portfolio quality and relevant experience



DESIRED NUMBER OF HOURS PER WEEK



15 hours






Enter the private
 address where you want to receive applicant notifications.



BUSINESS OR CONTACT NAME



Enter your public name or the public name of the study and community.



SELECT UP TO 3 SKILLS



1. Graphic Design  

2. Video Editing  

3. Social Media Marketing

title: End-to-End Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
description:
We run two complementary Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across 
, 
, and 
, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships: production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales, so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000), equivalent to $11 to $14 per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

Shore Vibes by Maria is a new coastal beach apparel and lifestyle brand based in New Jersey, alongside our sister vacation rental company Shore Summer Rentals. We’re looking for an experienced VA to take over product uploads, store management, and SEO optimization — then stay on long-term as we grow.



This position is not for someone who is looking to be trained, I am looking for someone who takes charge and gets the job done with little hand holding. Pay is based on experience.



What you’ll do:



• Add and edit products (titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing)

• Make theme edits using CSS — section layouts, styling tweaks, seasonal updates

• Update homepage banners, collections, and promotions

• Create and manage our Etsy shop, including listings and shop settings

• Manage our Printify account — product setup, mockups, order syncing

• Optimize SEO across Shopify and Etsy: keyword research, tags, meta titles, meta descriptions

• Create ads for social media

• Help manage Shore Summer Rentals
 pages, including replying to guests asking about vacation rentals and owners interested in advertising with us



Who we need:



Attention to detail matters more than speed. If you’re someone who double-checks your own work before turning it in, this is for you. If you tend to move fast and figure it out later, this isn’t a fit.



Requirements:



• Advanced, hands-on Shopify experience, including CSS theme customization

• Proven experience creating and managing Etsy shops

• Proven experience managing Printify accounts (product setup, order fulfillment)

• Strong working knowledge of SEO — keyword research, tags, meta titles, meta descriptions

• A portfolio of real Shopify and Etsy Etsy stores you’ve built or managed (links required)

• At least 2 professional references from past clients

• Excellent written English — you’ll be corresponding directly with our rental clients and hosts

• Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight

• Willingness to complete a short skills/English test before final hiring decision



Nice to have: Meta Pixel, Canva or Kittl, prior experience in customer service or hospitality



To apply, please include, in this order:



1. Start your message with the word “vibes” — this just tells us you read the full post

2. A short note on your Shopify, Etsy, and Printify experience

3. Links to 2–3 stores you’ve worked on

4. Two references (name, relationship, contact info)

Applications missing the portfolio, references, or the word above won’t be reviewed.



We’re a small brand and this only works if we can trust the work without re-checking it. If that’s how you operate, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Shopify expert
description:
# Shopify Store Builder / Landing Page Specialist



We are looking for an experienced **Shopify Specialist** to join our e-commerce team for long-term cooperation.



This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows Shopify very well and can work independently. **We are not looking for a beginner.** You should be comfortable working inside Shopify without needing explanations of basic features or processes.



## Your Main Responsibilities



Your daily tasks will include:



* Building and editing Shopify product pages

* Creating advertorial pages and landing pages

* Adding and launching new products

* Setting up and managing Shopify Markets

* Creating localized versions of stores and products for different countries

* Copying and recreating page structures from reference websites

* Building pages inspired by existing competitors and successful stores

* Making adjustments to existing product pages and advertorials

* Handling general Shopify-related tasks required to launch and test new products



Most daily tasks will be connected to either:



**1. Launching a new product** — creating the product page, advertorial, and everything needed to prepare it for advertising.



**2. Working on an existing product** — for example, adding a new advertorial, creating a new landing page, or preparing the product for another market.



We will usually provide you with reference websites, competitor pages, or examples of what we want. Your job is to recreate the structure, adapt it to our brand and product, and make sure everything works correctly.



## Requirements



You should:



* Have strong practical experience with Shopify

* Be able to work independently inside Shopify

* Know how to build and customize product pages and landing pages

* Understand Shopify Markets and multi-country store setups

* Be comfortable working with Shopify themes and Custom Liquid

* Be able to recreate designs and page structures based on reference websites

* Have good attention to detail

* Work efficiently and follow daily tasks and deadlines

* Be able to solve basic Shopify problems independently



**You should not need training on Shopify basics.** We are looking for someone who can receive a task and start working on it immediately.



Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Liquid is a strong advantage.



## About the Work



We operate multiple e-commerce stores and regularly test and launch new products across different markets.



There is a continuous flow of work. Some days you may build a completely new product page and advertorial. On other days, you may adapt an existing product to a new country, create another advertorial, or improve an existing landing page.



We are looking for someone reliable who wants to work with us **long-term** and become an important part of our e-commerce operation.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short introduction about your Shopify experience

* Examples of Shopify stores, landing pages, or advertorials you have built

* How many years you have worked with Shopify

* Your experience with Shopify Markets and multi-language/multi-country stores

* Your availability and expected monthly salary



Please include the word **"SHOPIFY"** at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.

title: AI Video Generator
description:
Got it — this is a narrower, more focused role: generating the AI avatars/presenters that appear in your videos, not owning the whole creative pipeline. Here's a tighter title and description for that.



AI Avatar Generation Specialist

(Alternatives: AI Avatar Producer, AI Presenter Specialist, or AI Avatar Artist.)

Remote · Full-Time (or Contract / Part-Time depending on volume)

Create the faces that front our videos.

We're looking for someone to generate the AI avatars and presenters used in our video ads. You'll take a concept — a look, a vibe, a type of person — and produce realistic, on-brand avatars that we drop into our creative. Your job is to make sure every presenter looks natural, credible, and consistent, ready to hand off to our video team.

You'll live inside tools like Higgsfield, and any other avatar and image-generation platforms that get the job done. The bar is realism and consistency: the same avatar should look like the same person across every video, and every face should feel like someone our audience would actually trust.

What you'll do



Generate AI avatars and presenters to spec — matching the look, age, tone, and feel we need for each campaign.

Keep avatars consistent. When we reuse a presenter, they need to look identical from video to video — same face, same identity, every time.

Iterate quickly on feedback — adjusting the look until it's right, without endless back-and-forth.

Deliver clean, usable assets organized and ready for the video team to animate or edit.

Keep it credible. Our audience is sharp and our category is full of obviously-fake AI presenters that kill trust. Your avatars need to look real and believable — not uncanny.

Stay current on avatar tools as they evolve, so our output keeps improving.



You'll thrive here if you...



? Have hands-on experience generating AI avatars or characters that look genuinely realistic

? Have a sharp eye for what reads as "real" vs. what looks artificial or off

? Can nail consistency — reproducing the same avatar reliably across many outputs

? Prompt with precision and iterate patiently until it's right

? Are fast, organized, and easy to hand work off to

? Keep up with avatar-generation tools as they change



This probably isn't for you if you're new to avatar generation, or you're satisfied with output that looks "good enough" but slightly uncanny. The realism bar here is high.



But that being said, when hiring we look more for intellect rather than perfect skills. You will be provided full training and help to get this perfect.



I'm looking forward to hearing from you, and I'm looking forward to working with you.

title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

•	Prepare clear management updates with risks, blockers, recommended decisions, next actions, and execution priorities.

•	Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, operation trackers, and Amazon operation documents organized and updated.

•	Flag weak assumptions, supplier risks, launch risks, listing risks, inventory risks, Amazon account concerns, or execution issues early.

•	For Lead-level candidates: review junior/support work, improve SOPs, templates, checklists, trackers, and help raise execution quality over time.





Qualifications:



•	Specialist level: 2-4+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	Lead level: 5-8+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	General Amazon FBA experience alone is not enough unless it includes hands-on Private Label work.

•	Experience with Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, post-launch monitoring, and Amazon operations support.

•	Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and structured research templates.

•	Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, profitability, launch difficulty, and product differentiation.

•	Strong supplier communication and follow-up skills, especially with China-based suppliers.

•	Strong written English communication and clear reporting ability.

•	Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product opportunities at different stages.

•	Comfortable following SOPs while also using judgment when a business decision requires practical thinking.

•	Comfortable using AI tools to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, workflow speed, and communication while verifying information carefully.

•	Able to work independently and provide clear updates, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

•	Comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon Private Label operations.





KPIs / Success Measures:



•	Quality and accuracy of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, listing preparation, launch support, and operation files.

•	Quality of product opportunity judgment and ability to separate weak products from realistic launch candidates.

•	Accuracy of market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, review analysis, profitability assumptions, and launch planning inputs.

•	Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, product improvement requests, sample coordination, and supplier follow-up.

•	Ability to identify risks early before they affect product selection, supplier selection, launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

•	Clear communication of blockers, risks, next steps, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.

•	Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, cost assumptions, and research reports.

•	Reliable ownership across product research, sourcing, product development, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

•	For Lead-level candidates: ability to improve execution quality, guide junior/support work, and improve SOPs, templates, or trackers when needed.

•	Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards while also applying sound judgment.





What We Offer:



•	Part-time or full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

•	Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

•	Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

•	Structured SOPs, templates, and process support.

•	Direct communication with company management.

•	Opportunity to grow into higher ownership based on proven capability and results.

•	Performance-based growth opportunities based on ownership, reliability, and execution quality.





Application Instructions:



To apply, please include the phrase "Amazon PL Role" in the first line of your application and answer the following questions briefly:

1.	Are you applying for Specialist level, Lead level, or open to either level based on assessment?

2.	Are you applying for full-time or part-time work? If part-time, how many hours per week can you consistently commit?

3.	How many years of direct Amazon Private Label experience do you have?

4.	Which Amazon tools have you used directly? Please mention Helium 10, Keepa, Seller Central, Alibaba, or others if applicable.

5.	Describe one private label product you helped identify, source, launch, improve, or scale. Please mention your exact role in the process.

6.	What makes a product a poor private label launch candidate, even if the sales look strong?

7.	Are you comfortable completing a practical Amazon PL assessment before final hiring?

title: Ecommerce Operations & General Assistant
description:
# General Assistant / Ecommerce VA



## Role Overview



We are looking for a reliable, organised, and proactive full-time Virtual Assistant to support the founder of two ecommerce pet supplement brands.



You will handle recurring administrative tasks, coordinate with suppliers, maintain reports and spreadsheets, manage bookings and schedules, and help with occasional creative and ecommerce tasks.



The workload may vary each day, but you must be available and responsive during agreed working hours.



## Key Responsibilities



* Update weekly KPI sheets and monthly P&L spreadsheets.

* Communicate with suppliers and organise supplier invoices and payments.

* Communicate with other tea
mbers to resolve one-off tasks

* Monitor and top up Meta advertising account balances.

* Manage
s, forms, meetings, calendar, and scheduling.

* Add and update product costs in profit tracking software.

* Contact software support teams and follow up until issues are resolved.

* Book flights, hotels, restaurants, and other appointments.

* Create and resize basic Meta advertising assets in Canva.

* Make simple edits to existing product-label files in Adobe Illustrator.

* Complete small administrative and research tasks for the founder and team.

* Organise files, documents, invoices, and recurring processes.

* Create simple SOPs and checklists for regular tasks.



## Must-Have Requirements



* At least two years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar.

* Strong experience using Google Drive, Sheets, Docs, Gmail, and Calendar.

* Good Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filters, and maintaining organised data.

* Strong Canva skills.

* Able to make basic edits to existing Adobe Illustrator files.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Highly organised with strong attention to detail.

* Comfortable working with invoices, costs, reports, and numbers.

* Able to manage recurring tasks without constant reminders.

* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable solving small problems independently.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup internet.

* Available full-time during agreed working hours.

* Comfortable handling confidential business and personal information.



## Preferred but Not Required



* Previous experience working for an ecommerce or DTC brand.

* Experience with Shopify, Meta Business Suite, or Meta Ads.

* Experience using TrueProfit or another profit-tracking platform.

* Basic bookkeeping or financial administration experience.

* Experience communicating with manufacturers or suppliers.

* Familiarity with Slack, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, or similar tools.

* Experience booking international travel.

* Experience in the pet, supplement, wellness, or consumer-products industry.



## What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is dependable, accurate, responsive, and comfortable handling a wide variety of small tasks. You should be able to follow instructions carefully, use good judgement, and complete recurring responsibilities without needing to be chased.



## Working Hours



This is a full-time role working from **8:00am to 4:00pm UK time, Monday to Friday**.



You must be online, available, and responsive throughout these working hours. The workload may vary from day to day, but you will be expected to remain available to receive and complete tasks during your shift.



You must not be working another full-time role that conflicts with these hours.



## Communication



Day-to-day communication will primarily take place through **Slack**.



You will report directly to the founder and will be expected to:



* Respond to messages promptly during working hours.

* Provide updates on tasks without needing to be chased.

* Ask clear questions when additional information is required.

* Flag delays, mistakes, or problems as soon as possible.

* Provide a brief update on completed and outstanding tasks when requested.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role if:



* Recurring tasks are completed accurately and on time.

* Tasks do not require repeated reminders or follow-ups.

* Supplier, software, and administrative issues are followed through until resolved.

* Files, spreadsheets, invoices, and information remain organised.

* You communicate clearly and raise problems before they become urgent.

* The founder is able to spend significantly less time on routine administrative work.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



* A brief introduction about yourself.

* A summary of your previous Virtual Assistant or assistant experience.

* Details of how long you worked in your previous assistant roles.

* Your experience using Google Sheets, Canva, and Adobe Illustrator.

* Any previous ecommerce experience.

* Examples of relevant Canva or Adobe Illustrator work, where available.

* Your current work commitments and confirmation that you can work from 8:00am to 4:00pm UK time.

* Your earliest available start date.

* Details of your computer, primary internet connection, and backup internet connection.



Please begin your application with the word **“Whiskers”** so we know you have read the full job posting.



## Hiring Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial video interview.



Candidates who progress beyond the first interview may be asked to complete a brief skills test involving tasks such as Google Sheets, written communication, task prioritisation, Canva, or basic Adobe Illustrator editing.



References may be requested before a final offer is made.

title: Stress-reduction Community Launch, Research Outreach & Partnerships Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



We are launching a stress-reduction study and educational community designed primarily for people ages 18–24.



The study will teach and explore practical, evidence-informed stress-management methods, including controlled breathing techniques, physical tension-release exercises, and mental relaxation techniques. Some of these approaches are also used in military resilience and performance-training environments.



Our goal is to make practical stress-management skills accessible, engaging, and relevant to young adults. This is an educational and research-focused initiative—not medical treatment—and no specific results are guaranteed.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced, highly personable Community Launch, Research Outreach & Partnerships Coordinator who can build and operate the initiative so the founder can focus on teaching.



You will help establish the community, recruit eligible study participants, build relationships with relevant organizations, communicate with prospective sponsors, coordinate events and content, manage follow-ups, and automate appropriate administrative tasks using AI.



This is not a basic administrative-assistant position. The right person is organized, resourceful, warm, persuasive, comfortable taking initiative, and able to represent a research-informed educational initiative professionally.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



COMMUNITY LAUNCH AND OPERATIONS



• Turn the launch strategy into a detailed project plan, timeline, and task list• Set up and organize the community platform• Create participant onboarding, FAQs, calendars, forms, resource libraries, and communication workflows• Coordinate launch content,
s, announcements, events, and reminders• Test the participant journey from initial interest through onboarding• Welcome participants and ensure questions receive timely responses• Maintain an organized project tracker and provide concise daily progress updates• Create clear SOPs for recurring activities• Handle operational details so the founder can concentrate on teaching



PARTICIPANT AND ORGANIZATIONAL OUTREACH



• Identify and contact fraternities, sororities, athletic organizations, student groups, campus leaders, clubs, youth organizations, and other relevant communities• Develop genuine relationships with organization leaders and community connectors• Build and maintain organized prospect lists• Write personalized outreach messages and follow-up sequences• Schedule introductory calls, presentations, workshops, and partnership discussions• Help recruit eligible study participants using approved language and processes• Track every conversation, follow-up, commitment, and next step• Communicate persistently without sounding robotic, pushy, or impersonal



SPONSORSHIPS AND PARTNERSHIPS



• Research companies and organizations aligned with the study’s audience and mission• Identify potential sponsors and the appropriate decision-makers• Help create sponsorship packages, proposals, presentations, and talking points• Conduct professional sponsor outreach by
, phone, and video call• Confidently explain the project’s purpose and potential value• Track sponsor conversations, proposals, follow-ups, and next steps• Help negotiate straightforward partnership arrangements with founder approval• Maintain positive, long-term relationships with sponsors and partners



AI AND AUTOMATION



• Use AI to research prospects, personalize outreach, summarize conversations, organize information, create content, and document processes• Identify repetitive administrative work that can be automated• Help create reliable workflows using tools such as ChatGPT, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, Make,
 platforms, scheduling tools, and CRMs• Review all AI-generated work for accuracy, personalization, quality, and appropriate tone• Maintain the human element in participant, partner, and sponsor communications• Never enter confidential participant information into an unapproved AI system



ON-CAMERA COMMUNICATION



The founder will provide the primary teaching. However, it is strongly preferred that you are also comfortable appearing on camera to:



• Welcome and onboard participants• Lead short orientation sessions• Demonstrate community tools and processes• Present approved breathing, tension-release, or mental-relaxation instructions• Interview community members or partners• Represent the initiative during selected calls and online events



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience launching or operating an online community, membership, course, research initiative, event, or digital program• Experience with outreach, partnerships, sponsorships, business development, lead generation, or consultative sales• Highly personable and able to establish trust quickly• Excellent spoken and written English• Confident communicating with students, organization leaders, and business sponsors• Strong project-management, organization, and follow-up skills• Comfortable using AI while maintaining accuracy and human judgment• Able to turn broad goals into organized systems and completed work• Able to work independently without constant supervision• Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional video-call environment



STRONGLY PREFERRED



• Existing connections with fraternities, sororities, athletic organizations, student groups, campus organizations, youth organizations, or brands serving young adults• Strong familiarity with the interests, concerns, communication styles, and online behavior of people ages 18–24• Experience securing sponsors or developing organizational partnerships• Experience recruiting participants for an educational program, study, membership, or event• Experience using a CRM and creating automated workflows• Comfortable teaching, presenting, or facilitating short sessions on camera• Experience with platforms such as Skool, Circle, Mighty Networks, 
, Kajabi,
 Groups, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, or Make



COMMUNICATION, PRIVACY, AND RESEARCH STANDARDS



All participant, partner, and sponsor communications must accurately describe the study and use approved language.



You must not:



• Make medical claims or diagnose participants• Promise that the techniques will produce specific results• Exaggerate the scientific evidence• Imply endorsement by the military or any other organization• Share confidential participant information• Enter protected or sensitive information into unapproved systems• Change study or consent language without approval



You will be expected to protect participant privacy and follow all supplied study, consent, communication, recruitment, and data-handling procedures.



SCHEDULE REQUIREMENT



You must be available Monday through Friday for a consistent daily collaboration period of at least 60–90 minutes scheduled sometime between 5:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.



Please provide the exact times you can consistently work during this window. Eastern Time includes seasonal daylight-saving changes.



The remaining working hours may be flexible, provided deadlines are met and communication is reliable.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



• The community and study operations are organized and ready for launch• The founder can focus primarily on teaching• Participant onboarding is clear, professional, and easy to follow• Outreach to relevant organizations occurs consistently• Prospects and follow-ups are accurately tracked• Partnership and sponsorship conversations increase• Communications remain personal, timely, and accurate• Problems and overdue tasks are identified before they delay the launch• Repetitive activities are documented and appropriately automated• Participant privacy and approved research procedures are consistently protected



HOW TO APPLY

Generic applications and applications that do not answer every question will not be considered.



WAGE/SALARY



$1,200–$1,600 USD per month, depending on relevant experience



Potential performance bonuses may be available for successful sponsorships or organizational partnerships. Bonuses will not be based on the number of study participants recruited.

title: Amazon Creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor

Position: Amazon Creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor
