About Us



We are a Canadian company building Amazon FBA private label and wholesale operations in the United States and Canada. We are looking for an Amazon private label creative designer who can support product launches with strong Amazon listing images, A+ Content, packaging visuals, product inserts, mockups, videos, and other launch-related creatives.



This is not a general graphic design role. We need someone with direct Amazon private label creative experience.





Experience Level Required



We are looking for an intermediate to senior-level creative designer with 2+ years of direct Amazon private label creative design experience.



Candidates should already understand Amazon listing image structure, product infographics, A+ Content, comparison charts, feature/benefit visuals, product image editing, packaging visuals, and conversion-focused Amazon product presentation.





Portfolio Required



Applications with relevant Amazon listing image, A+ Content, product image, packaging, ad creative, or product video samples are preferred.





Role Overview



You will help create end-to-end creative assets for Amazon FBA private label product launches. The work may include listing image sets, product infographics, A+ Content, product mockups, packaging visuals, inserts, short product videos, ad creatives, and other Amazon launch-related assets.



The main goal is to make physical products look clear, premium, trustworthy, and conversion-focused on Amazon.





Key Responsibilities



• Design complete Amazon listing image sets, including main image concepts, secondary images, benefit images, product-in-use visuals, bundle visuals, and comparison graphics.

• Create product infographics showing features, dimensions, materials, benefits, use cases, bundle contents, and customer pain-point solutions.

• Design A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content, brand story visuals, comparison modules, and product education graphics.

• Create packaging concepts, box mockups, labels, inserts, thank-you cards, instruction cards, and other printed assets.

• Edit supplier images, sample photos, product photos, lifestyle images, and raw product visuals for Amazon use.

• Create or edit short product videos, product demo videos, listing videos, ad-style videos, and launch creatives when needed.

• Create ad creatives, promo graphics, storefront visuals, banners, icons, badges, and other Amazon brand assets.

• Use AI tools when useful for creative ideation, mockups, image support, video support, and workflow speed, while checking quality and accuracy.

• Keep creative files, source files, exports, versions, and references organized in Google Drive.

• Communicate clearly about completed work, design notes, missing assets, blockers, revisions, and next steps.





Requirements



• 2+ years of direct Amazon creative design experience required, including Amazon listing images, product infographics, A+ Content, product image editing, comparison charts, packaging visuals, inserts, product mockups, and/or Amazon product videos.

• Intermediate to senior-level design ability required.

• Strong portfolio required.

• Strong static design ability required.

• Basic-to-intermediate video editing ability strongly preferred.

• Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, AI image/video tools, or similar tools.

• Good understanding of Amazon product presentation, listing image structure, layout, typography, image clarity, visual hierarchy, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to create clean, professional, premium-looking visuals for physical products.

• Strong attention to detail with spelling, product claims, dimensions, packaging text, image sizes, file formats, and revisions.

• Organized, reliable, responsive, and comfortable working independently.





Not Suitable For



This role is not suitable for candidates whose experience is mainly general VA work, customer service, basic Canva templates, logo-only design, or social-media-only graphics. We are looking for someone with Amazon private label product creative ability.





How to Apply



To apply, start your message with:



“Amazon Creative Designer”



Then include:



1. Your portfolio link

2. Your direct Amazon creative experience

3. Your experience with listing images, infographics, A+ Content, packaging, inserts, mockups, and video

4. The tools you use

5. Your expected rate

6. Your availability and earliest start date

title: Assistant Vibe Coder
description:
# AI-Assisted Developer / Vibe Coder — Long-Term Position



We’re looking for a smart, resourceful **AI-Assisted Developer / Vibe Coder** to join our team long-term and help us build websites, web applications, internal tools, automations, and other digital projects.



You do **not** need to be a senior software engineer.



We’re looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of coding and, most importantly, knows how to use AI tools effectively to **build quickly, solve problems, debug issues, and figure things out independently.**



If you love experimenting with AI, coding, and finding smarter ways to build things, this could be a great fit.



## What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll work directly with me across a variety of projects, including:



* Building and modifying websites and web applications

* Using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar

* Working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks

* Building APIs, integrations, and automations

* Using browser automation tools such as Playwright

* Debugging and solving technical problems with AI

* Testing websites and applications

* Working with GitHub and existing codebases

* Researching and experimenting with new AI tools and workflows

* Helping build internal tools that make our work faster and more efficient

* Assisting with various technical and development tasks



Some projects may involve things neither of us has built before.



That’s completely fine.



You should be comfortable researching, experimenting, and using AI to figure things out rather than waiting for detailed step-by-step instructions.



## What We’re Looking For



You should have:



* Basic to intermediate coding knowledge

* Experience using AI coding tools

* Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

* Familiarity with Git and GitHub

* Comfortable using Terminal and command-line tools

* Ability to understand and modify existing code

* Strong problem-solving and research skills

* Good English communication

* Reliable internet and your own computer

* Ability to work independently and learn quickly



Experience with any of the following is a bonus:



* Claude Code

* OpenAI Codex

* Cursor

* Next.js / React

* Node.js

* WordPress / WooCommerce

* Shopify

* Playwright / browser automation

* APIs and webhooks

* Vercel

* MCP servers and AI agents

* AI image and video tools

* Automation tools and workflows



You **do not need to know everything on this list**.



Your ability to learn, adapt, and use AI effectively is more important than already knowing every technology.



## The Type of Person We Want



We want someone whose mindset is:



**“I don’t know how to do this yet, but I can figure it out.”**



We are not looking for someone who needs detailed instructions for every single task.



We want someone who is naturally curious and willing to experiment.



If something doesn’t work, you research it, ask AI, try another approach, debug it, and keep going until you find a solution.



AI is changing how software and digital products are built, and we actively embrace it.



You don’t need to manually write every line of code.



We actually **want you to use AI**.



What matters is that you understand what you’re building, can identify when something isn’t working, and know how to use the tools available to get to a working result.



## Long-Term Opportunity



This is **not a one-off freelance project**.



We’re looking for someone who can become a long-ter
mber of our team.



Initially, you’ll work closely with me and assist with development, automation, and technical projects.



As you learn how we work and demonstrate your abilities, you’ll be trusted with increasingly larger projects and more independence.



There will be opportunities for **increased compensation and responsibility as you grow with the company.**



We want someone who is excited about AI and technology and wants to grow alongside a fast-moving business.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. **What laptop/computer do you currently use?** Please include the model and specifications, including your processor/chip and RAM.



3. Send examples of anything you’ve built. This could include websites, apps, automations, scripts, personal projects, GitHub repositories, or anything else you’re proud of.



4. Which AI coding tools do you currently use? For example: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, or others.



5. Tell us about your coding experience and which technologies you’re most comfortable working with.



6. Tell us about **one real project you built using AI**. Briefly explain what you built, how you used AI to build it, what problems you encountered, and how you solved them.



At the **very beginning of your application**, write the word:



**MANGO**



Applications that do not include this word will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a **small practical AI coding challenge** before moving to the interview stage.



We care less about degrees, certificates, or how many years you’ve been coding.



What we care about is:



**Can you learn quickly, use AI effectively, figure things out, and build things that actually work?**



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Tech Lead — Hospitality Commerce Platform & AI-First Development
description:
Tech Lead — Hospitality Commerce Platform & AI-First Development

**Danner Enterprises / Save on Branson · Branson, MO (hybrid or remote considered) · Full-time**



---



The Short Version



We run a hospitality and vacation portfolio in Branson, Missouri — show tickets, lodging, tours, vacation rentals — with **$20M+/year flowing through a custom platform we call SMASH**: 248 daily users, 978,000 customer records, 371,000 orders, and a decade of real business logic.



The developer who built most of it over the last 4.5 years is transitioning out. We're not replacing her with a bigger team — we're moving to an **AI-first development model**: AI coding agents generate most of the code; one exceptional human tech lead reviews it, deploys it, owns the architecture, and makes the calls.



That human is you.



This is a rare kind of role: total technical ownership of a revenue-critical system, a mandate to modernize it, and a front-row seat (driver's seat, actually) in how AI-assisted development actually works at a real company — not a demo, not a lab.



---



What You'll Own



**A legacy system that pays the bills.** ASP.NET Zero / ABP Framework 
 8 (we just completed the 3.1 ? 8 migration), Angular 8 front end, EF Core + Dapper, SQL Server (237 tables, 903 migrations), Hangfire, Redis, SignalR, GraphQL. It handles contacts, orders, tickets, lodging, tours, vouchers, and commissions for 11 business entities. It works. Your job is to keep it working while making it better.



**A modern system that's replacing it, piece by piece.** A .NET 10 Clean Architecture build (`SOB.*`): stored-procedure-first data access (Insight.Database), DbUp migrations, a Vite/JavaScript campaign UI, a REST API replacing the legacy RPC surface, and an SMS campaign engine (ClickSend, GoTo Connect, consent/opt-out management, Hangfire send engine). Both systems share one database — schema changes are a coordination discipline, and you'll own it.



**A production MCP server.** `SOB.Mcp` — built on the official C# Model Context Protocol SDK — already gives AI agents structured, auth-forwarded access to platform data. You'll extend it: more tools, more capabilities, more of the business safely exposed to agents.



**The AI development pipeline itself.** AI agents submit PRs against the repo daily. You review them, harden them, merge them, and deploy them. You maintain the CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md context documentation that keeps agent output quality high. Target state: 80–120 commits/month shipping through your review, with you as the quality gate — not the bottleneck.



**The integration estate.** Stripe, ActiveCampaign, GoTo Connect, Five9, Twilio, RingCentral, ClickSend, Contentful, Zapier, outbound webhooks to automation platforms. Phones and payments are this business — the integrations are not side quests.



---



 Your First 90 Days (Real Backlog, Not Boilerplate)



We believe in showing you the actual work. If this list makes you lean in, apply. If it makes you wince, we've saved us both time.



- Fix an ActiveCampaign sync integration that's logging millions of error rows at a 99.9?ilure rate — while the business thinks it's fine

- Triage 215 failed Hangfire jobs and stand up failure alerting

- Stand up CI/CD on Azure DevOps (PR ? build ? staging auto-deploy) to replace manual, single-person deployments

- Design and run a backfill inferring order status for 308,000 orders where it's NULL (83% of all orders)

- Reconcile a six-figure gap between recorded transactions and orders

- Close a 378,000-ticket gap in our voucher/billing pipeline

- Groom a 178-item backlog, kill the zombies, and set priorities with leadership

- Continue porting ~22 legacy API endpoints to the new REST surface

- Absorb a structured knowledge transfer from the outgoing developer (recorded walkthroughs, deployment procedures, the undocumented quirks)

- Make the first calls on two end-of-life fronts: Angular 8 and Xamarin mobile



---



 What We Need You To Bring



**The legacy depth (non-negotiable)**

- 7+ years of professional C#/.NET, with current production experience 
 8+

- Deep experience with a heavily-opinionated enterprise framework — ABP / ASP.NET Zero is the dream; an equivalent conventions-based monolith (with its DI container, module system, and dynamic API layer) is acceptable if you can prove you reverse-engineer framework internals from source

- Expert SQL Server, in multiple paradigms: EF Core migrations at scale, stored-procedure-first access, Dapper, and script-based deployment (DbUp). You've managed schema changes on a database that more than one application depends on.

- Large-scale data-quality engineering: backfills, reconciliations, deduplication — safely, auditable, reversible

- Authentication breadth: JWT bearer internals (if you've debugged 
 8 `TokenHandlers` vs `SecurityTokenValidators` change, mention it — you'll make our shortlist), Auth0 machine-to-machine, API-key schemes, custom token handlers

- Production integration engineering: payments, SMS at scale with consent/opt-out compliance, telephony webhooks, marketing automation APIs — with idempotency, retries, and activity logging as instincts, not afterthoughts

- Hangfire, Redis, SignalR; Docker builds; Azure DevOps

- Front-end pragmatism: you can maintain an Angular 8 app and a Vite/vanilla-JS app without needing either to be your favorite

- Testing discipline: xUnit, mocking, and written test plans/verification results as release artifacts



**The AI fluency (equally non-negotiable)**

- You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) daily and seriously — and you know exactly where they hallucinate in legacy codebases (migrations, auth config, framework conventions) and how to gate for it

- You've built or extended an MCP server, or can show us a real tool-calling / structured-output LLM integration you shipped to production

- You can write and maintain repo AI-context documentation as a first-class engineering artifact

- You have opinions about reviewing AI-generated PRs at volume — formed by doing it



**The judgment**

- You've been the person a business depended on before, and it didn't scare you

- You default to guardrails-before-velocity: tests and CI first, then speed

- You'd rather inherit a profitable, imperfect system than build a perfect one nobody uses



---



 Nice to Have



- Prior ASP.NET Zero / aspnetboilerplate commercial project (tell us immediately)

- Xamarin ? .NET MAUI migration experience; Angular major-version upgrade or SPA strangler-replacement leadership

- 
; voice AI or real-time telephony pipelines; Supabase / Next.js / Vercel

- E-commerce cart, pricing, voucher, or commission domain experience

- Hospitality, ticketing, or OTA industry background

- You've led a framework migration (.NET 3.1 ? 8 ? 10 or similar) and lived to document it



---



Why This Role Is Different



**Total ownership.** No committee. You are the technical authority, working directly with the owner/architect and leadership. Your decisions ship.



**The AI-first model is real here, not a press release.** AI agents already have commit history in this repo. A production MCP server already runs. Your leverage is the point of the job.



**The system matters.** This isn't an internal tool nobody uses. Two hundred forty-eight people run their workday through it, and $20M+ of real revenue depends on it staying up.



**The problems are honest.** We showed you the backlog above — including the ugly parts — because the right candidate finds a 99.9%-error-rate integration *interesting*.



---



Logistics



- **Location:** Branson, MO preferred (hybrid); remote considered for an exceptional fit (US time zones)

- **Compensation:** Competitive, commensurate with the scope above — we know what total ownership is worth

- **Reports to:** Ownership/leadership, working alongside our AI development agents and a project-based systems architect



---



How to Apply



Skip the cover letter. Send us:



1. **Your resume and why you are the best candidate for the job**

2. **One paragraph on the gnarliest legacy system you've owned** — what it was, what broke, what you did

3. **Proof of AI fluency** — a repo, an MCP server, a PR trail, a writeup, anything that shows you actually work this way

4. **(Bonus)** Your answer to this: *"You inherit a .NET 8 app where JWTs validate successfully but the session user ID comes back null. Where do you look first?"*



If you've read this far and you're already thinking about the NULL-status backfill strategy — we should talk.



Really want to jump to the front of the line?  Respond to my test questions.  No cheating.  Send this with everything else when you apply:



Here it is in plain text, ready to paste straight into an Onlinejobs.ph message or application form. I've reworded them slightly for written async answers and added length guidance so applicants know what "done" looks like:



SCREENING QUESTIONS — Please answer all 7 in your reply.

Short, direct answers are fine (3-6 sentences each). We are

looking for how you think, not essay length. If you don't

know an answer, say so honestly — guessing hurts you more

than a straight "I haven't hit that one yet."



1. We upgraded a .NET app 
 Core 3.1 
 8.

JWT tokens still validate successfully, but the session

user ID now comes back null. Where do you look first,

and why?



2. You inherit a legacy app where Program.cs still uses

WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder instead of the modern Generic

Host. An AI coding agent submits a PR "modernizing" it to

Host.CreateDefaultBuilder. What do you do before merging?



3. 83% of our orders (about 308,000 rows) have a NULL

Status column. We can infer the correct status from related

data (cancellations, payment transactions, arrival dates).

Outline your approach to backfilling this safely.



4. An integration sync job has logged 3.9 million error

rows at a 99.9?ilure rate, but the business says the

integration works fine and their data looks correct.

What is your first move, and what would you NOT do yet?



5. You are the only human reviewer in a team where AI

agents (Claude Code / Codex) generate most pull requests.

An agent submits a 15-file PR that touches an EF Core

migration and auth configuration in a codebase you've

owned for only two months. Walk me through your review

process, step by step.



6. Two applications share one SQL Server database. One

uses EF Core with a 900-migration history. The other uses

stored procedures deployed with DbUp SQL scripts. You need

to alter a core table that both depend on. How do you do

it without breaking either app?



7. We have an MCP server that exposes contact search to

AI agents. It is a zero-identity proxy that forwards the

caller's auth to our API. We now want to add a tool that

lets AI agents send SMS campaigns to customers. What

concerns would you raise before building it?



BONUS (optional, strong answers get priority review):

Link us to proof you work with AI coding tools daily —

a repo, an MCP server you built, a PR history, or a

short writeup of your workflow.

title: Video Editor for DTC Brand — Meta Ad Creatives
description:
We're a fast-moving DTC e-commerce brand selling cleaning products across AU, NZ, UK, and EU markets. We run paid social hard — Meta is our primary channel — and we need a video editor who gets ads, not just editing.



WHAT THIS ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



Editing UGC-style video ad creatives for Meta (Reels/Stories/Feed)

Working from mash-up footage + AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) to produce scroll-stopping hooks

Executing batch creative production — we test multiple hooks, angles, and formats per cycle

Iterating fast on winning concepts: resizing, recuts, new hooks on existing bodies

Adding clean motion graphics where the ad calls for it — text callouts, price tags, arrows, before/after wipes, comparison layouts

Occasional longer-form advertorial and VSL-style edits (2–4 min), where the job is holding attention across a full narrative, not just winning the first 2 seconds

Delivering clean exports ready to upload — no back-and-forth on basics



Volume: roughly 10 concepts per week, briefed by our Creative Strategist.



YOU'RE THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU



Have real experience editing direct-response Meta ads for DTC/e-commerce brands

Understand hook structure, problem-agitate-solution, and why the first 2 seconds d
 everything

Can work from a creative brief without needing your hand held

Are comfortable with CapCut, Premiere, or similar — tool matters less than output

Can build clean motion graphics that look premium, not templated

Work AI into your process — Higgsfield, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, Suno. We use AI to widen creative range and speed, never as a shortcut to low-quality output

Have a portfolio with actual ad creatives, not just brand videos or organic content



BONUS POINTS



Experience with ugly ads / lo-fi UGC style

Can suggest angles or hook variations, not just execute

Experience with advertorial or VSL-style long-form

EU/UK market exposure



THE ROLE



Ongoing, long-term for the right person

Remote, async-friendly, GMT+8 — no graveyard shifts

Direct work with our Creative Strategist. No layers, no bureaucracy

We move fast — turnaround matters



HOW THIS PAYS



We don't pay hourly. We pay per concept, plus bonuses when your work scales.

Base: $15 per concept, paid monthly



Bonuses — paid on ad spend, cumulative:



+$10 — your concept passes $1,000 in ad spend

+$25 — your concept passes $2,500 in ad spend

+$50 — your concept passes $5,000 in ad spend at 2.5 ROAS or above



A concept that scales all the way earns you $85 on top of the base.



How we keep it fair: every concept you deliver gets tested within 14 days — if we don't test it, you're paid the first tier anyway. Every test runs the same budget and structure, so you're judged on your creative and nothing else. You get a live scoreboard showing what every concept you've made has spent, what it returned, and what you've earned.



TO APPLY



Start your message with BLUEBIRD so I know you read this.

Send your portfolio + 2–3 examples of Meta ad creatives you've edited. Tell me what the ad was for and whether it ran.

Tell me which AI tools you actually use and how.

Your expected rate and earliest start date.



Shortlisted applicants do a paid test edit on our footage.

title: E-commerce  growth manager
description:
Part-Time E-Commerce Growth Manager



Shopify, Meta Ads,
 Marketing & Conversion Optimization



Company: Winx+Blinx

Industry: Luxury Baby, Gift and Home Products

Work Arrangement: Remote

Schedule: Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week

Position Type: Long-term role, beginning with a paid 60–90 day trial period



About Winx+Blinx



Winx+Blinx is an established luxury baby and lifestyle brand specializing in premium blankets, hooded towels, loveys, personalized gifts, gift sets and home accessories.



We are now focused on significantly expanding our direct-to-consumer online business.



Our brand is known for luxurious textures, thoughtful personalization, beautiful gift-ready presentation and a clean, elegant visual identity. We are not looking for someone to simply maintain our website or post content. We are looking for a strategic, analytical and highly proactive E-Commerce Growth Manager who can turn website visitors into customers, increase repeat purchases and help us grow online revenue consistently.



The Role



The E-Commerce Growth Manager will take ownership of the strategy and execution required to grow sales through our Shopify website.



You will analyze our current performance, identify missed opportunities and implement improvements across website conversion, paid advertising,
 marketing, product merchandising, promotions, customer retention and reporting.



This is a hands-on role. You must be comfortable doing the work yourself—not only making recommendations or waiting for other tea
mbers to implement them.



You will work closely with the founder. The content creator will focus primarily on producing brand visuals, social media content and creative assets. You will be responsible for determining how those assets should be used to support sales, advertising campaigns, website improvements and customer acquisition.



Primary Goal



Your main goal is to increase profitable online sales for Winx+Blinx.



Success will be measured through improvements in areas such as:



- Website conversion rate

- Total online revenue

- Average order value

-
-generated revenue

- Returning-customer rate

- Add-to-cart and checkout completion rates

- Cost per acquisition

- Meta Ads performance

- Return on advertising spend

- Customer lifetime value



Key Responsibilities



1. E-Commerce Growth Strategy



- Review our Shopify website, analytics, customer journey and existing marketing efforts.

- Create a clear 30-, 60- and 90-day growth plan.

- Identify the most important opportunities to increase revenue and prioritize them according to potential impact.

- Develop monthly promotional and marketing plans around product launches, gift-giving occasions, holidays, personalization and seasonal buying behavior.

- Recommend practical strategies based on data, not generic marketing advice.

- Balance short-term revenue opportunities with long-term brand growth and customer retention.

- Present ideas clearly to the founder and explain why each recommendation should improve performance.



2. Shopify Website Conversion Optimization



- Review the full customer journey from the homepage through product discovery, cart and checkout.

- Identify website issues that may be preventing customers from purchasing.

- Improve homepage structure, collection pages, product pages, navigation, product recommendations and calls to action.

- Make sure customers immediately understand the quality, value, benefits and uniqueness of our products.

- Improve product descriptions, merchandising and presentation to support stronger conversion.

- Test strategies such as bundles, upsells, cross-sells, complementary products and gift-set recommendations.

- Improve the presentation of personalization options and gift-ready features.

- Review mobile usability and ensure the mobile shopping experience is easy and attractive.

- Recommend and implement appropriate Shopify apps only when they provide a clear benefit.

- Avoid unnecessarily adding apps that slow down the website or create additional expenses.

- Monitor website speed and customer experience.

- Plan and evaluate A/B tests or structured conversion tests when appropriate.

- Help increase average order value without damaging the premium brand experience.



3. Meta Ads Management



- Develop and manage Meta advertising campaigns across
 and Instagram.

- Review any existing campaigns, tracking and account structure.

- Confirm that the Meta Pixel, Conversion API and relevant events are installed and functioning correctly.

- Build campaigns for customer acquisition, retargeting, product launches, best sellers, gift sets and seasonal promotions.

- Create clear campaign structures with appropriate audiences, budgets and objectives.

- Develop creative briefs for the content creator based on advertising needs.

- Test multiple creative concepts, messages, hooks, audiences and offers.

- Monitor advertising performance consistently and make informed adjustments.

- Pause weak campaigns and scale stronger campaigns responsibly.

- Track cost per purchase, return on ad spend, click-through rate, conversion rate and other meaningful performance indicators.

- Clearly explain what is working, what is not working and why.

- Work effectively with an initially modest advertising budget.

- Understand that strong performance must be demonstrated before recommending major increases in advertising spend.

- Avoid relying only on boosted posts or vanity metrics such as likes and followers.



Experience managing e-commerce Meta Ads with limited or growing budgets is highly preferred.



4.
 and Customer Retention Marketing



- Review or help set up our
 marketing platform and customer segmentation.

- Create or improve essential automated
 flows, including:

  - Welcome series

  - Abandoned-cart flow

  - Abandoned-checkout flow

  - Browse-abandonment flow

  - Post-purchase follow-up

  - Product-review request

  - Cross-sell and complementary-product flow

  - Repeat-purchase or customer win-back flow

  - Personalized-product education

  - Back-in-stock notifications

- Create a realistic
 campaign calendar.

- Develop campaigns for launches, new collections, best sellers, gift sets, holidays and promotions.

- Segment customers based on purchase history, engagement, product interest and customer behavior.

- Improve
 subject lines, offers, messaging and calls to action.

- Monitor revenue generated from
, open rates, click rates, conversion and unsubscribe rates.

- Maintain a premium brand voice and avoid excessive discounting or sending too many promotional
s.



5. Product Merchandising and Promotional Strategy



- Identify products with the strongest potential for acquisition, gifting, bundling and repeat purchases.

- Recommend which products should be featured on the homepage and in paid campaigns.

- Create strategies for best sellers, new arrivals, seasonal items, personalized products and gift sets.

- Help develop bundles that make purchasing easier and increase order value.

- Recommend strategic offers without weakening the luxury positioning of the brand.

- Review product pricing, perceived value and promotional opportunities.

- Help plan inventory-focused promotions when appropriate.

- Use sales and customer data to identify which products should receive more attention.

- Make sure promotions are easy for customers to understand and profitable for the company.



6. Analytics, Tracking and Reporting



- Review Shopify analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics and other available reporting tools.

- Verify that tracking is accurate before making major conclusions.

- Establish baseline performance metrics at the beginning of the role.

- Create a simple weekly dashboard or report that the founder can easily understand.

- Track the most meaningful performance indicators rather than overwhelming the team with unnecessary data.

- Use data to identify customer behavior, sales patterns and areas of lost revenue.

- Clearly connect completed work to measurable business results.



Your weekly report should include:



- Work completed during the week

- Current website sales and conversion performance

- Meta advertising spend and results

-
 campaign and automation performance

- Changes in average order value

- Important observations or concerns

- Tests currently running

- Results from completed tests

- Priorities for the following week

- Any assets or decisions needed from the founder



7. Collaboration and Communication



- Communicate directly and clearly with the founder.

- Work collaboratively with our content creator.

- Provide the content creator with specific briefs for advertising and sales-focused assets.

- Request the exact materials needed instead of giving vague directions.

- Maintain organized task lists, deadlines and project updates.

- Raise problems early rather than waiting until a deadline is missed.

- Be comfortable receiving feedback and adjusting quickly.

- Respect the established Winx+Blinx brand identity.

- Maintain consistent communication during agreed working hours.

- Attend a weekly strategy and performance meeting.



First 30 Days



During the first month, we expect the selected candidate to:



- Complete a full audit of the Shopify website and online sales funnel.

- Review current analytics, conversion rate, traffic sources and sales performance.

- Review Meta advertising accounts and tracking.

- Review current
 marketing setup and automations.

- Identify the biggest obstacles affecting online sales.

- Establish baseline performance metrics.

- Create a prioritized 30-, 60- and 90-day growth plan.

- Implement the highest-impact website improvements.

- Improve or launch essential abandoned-cart and welcome
 flows.

- Develop the first structured Meta Ads testing plan.

- Create a promotional and campaign calendar.

- Establish a clear weekly reporting system.



We do not expect every issue to be solved immediately. However, we expect the candidate to quickly identify priorities, take action and demonstrate organized progress.



Required Qualifications



Applicants should have:



- Proven experience growing sales for a Shopify-based e-commerce brand.

- Strong understanding of Shopify, online merchandising and conversion optimization.

- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for physical consumer products.

- Experience building and optimizing
 campaigns and automated flows.

- Strong understanding of customer acquisition and customer retention.

- Ability to analyze data and turn it into practical action.

- Experience improving conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- Excellent written English and clear verbal communication.

- Strong organizational and project-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage priorities without constant supervision.

- A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

- Experience collaborating with designers, content creators or founders.

- Respect for luxury branding and visual consistency.

- The ability to explain marketing performance in language that a business owner can easily understand.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be especially valuable:



- Experience with baby, children’s, gifting, home, lifestyle, fashion or luxury consumer brands.

- Experience marketing personalized products.

- Experience with gift-focused e-commerce businesses.

- Experience working with a founder-led small or midsize brand.

- Experience growing a business with a modest initial advertising budget.

- Experience with Klaviyo or a comparable e-commerce
 platform.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4.

- Experience with Shopify reporting and customer segmentation.

- Experience creating product bundles, upsells and cross-sells.

- Experience planning holiday and seasonal sales campaigns.

- Basic ability to make Shopify theme updates or coordinate simple technical changes.

- Understanding of SEO fundamentals.

- Familiarity with Google Shopping or other paid acquisition channels is a plus, but Meta Ads will be the initial priority.



Who Will Be Successful in This Role?



This role is best for someone who:



- Thinks like an owner and takes responsibility for results.

- Enjoys finding opportunities that others overlook.

- Is both strategic and hands-on.

- Can work with limited resources and prioritize intelligently.

- Understands that revenue growth requires more than posting on social media.

- Is comfortable testing ideas and learning from the results.

- Does not make unrealistic guarantees.

- Communicates honestly when something is not working.

- Focuses on profitable sales rather than vanity metrics.

- Can protect a premium brand while still driving strong action and conversion.

- Understands the emotional nature of baby gifting and can translate that into effective marketing.

- Can move forward independently after receiving clear goals and brand direction.



This Position Is Not a Fit for Someone Who:



- Only provides strategies but does not implement them.

- Mainly specializes in organic social media management.

- Measures success primarily through likes, views or followers.

- Has no direct experience with Shopify e-commerce.

- Has never managed paid advertising for physical products.

- Uses the same generic strategy for every business.

- Requires constant direction for routine tasks.

- Cannot explain advertising performance clearly.

- Recommends increasing advertising budgets without first improving tracking, creative and conversion.

- Makes guaranteed promises about revenue or return on ad spend.

- Does not pay close attention to brand presentation.

- Is managing too many clients to give this role consistent attention.



Working Hours and Availability



This is initially a part-time role requiring approximately 15–20 hours per week.



The schedule can be flexible, but the selected candidate must:



- Maintain consistent weekly availability.

- Complete agreed assignments by their deadlines.

- Respond to important messages within a reasonable timeframe.

- Be available for one scheduled weekly meeting.

- Be able to communicate during at least some overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Provide advance notice regarding planned time off or changes in availability.



The position may grow in hours and responsibility based on performance, business needs and measurable sales growth.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, skills and demonstrated results.



Please include your requested:



- Hourly rate

- Monthly part-time rate for 15–20 hours per week

- Preferred payment structure

- Weekly availability

- Earliest possible start date



Please do not apply with commission-only proposals. A performance bonus may be considered after a strong baseline of performance, accurate tracking and clearly defined targets have been established.



Trial Period



The selected candidate will begin with a paid 60–90 day trial period.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate:



- Quality and speed of implementation

- Strategic thinking

- Communication

- Organization

- Reliability

- Ability to understand our customers and brand

- Improvement in website performance

- Quality of advertising decisions

- Ability to use data effectively

- Overall contribution to online revenue growth



Continuing the position long-term will depend on performance, collaboration and the quality of the candidate’s work.



How to Apply



To be considered, please begin your application with the words:



“I am ready to grow Winx+Blinx.”



Applications that do not include this sentence may not be reviewed.



Additionally, please include the word “blanket” somewhere naturally in your application to confirm that you have carefully read this entire posting.



Please provide the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for Winx+Blinx.

title: Account Manager (MSP) - QBRs, Client Success, AI-Aware - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and we are hiring an Account Manager in the Philippines to own our client relationships and run our Quarterly Business Reviews.



Right now the owner does this job. That is the problem. He cannot scale, and our clients deserve someone whose whole job is thinking about them.



WHAT A QBR IS, AND WHY IT MATTERS HERE



Every quarter we sit down with a client and show them they are not on autopilot - that we are measuring their environment, we know where it is weak, and we have a plan. We use ScalePad Lifecycle Manager to do it.



Our internal playbook defines success in one sentence, and this is the standard you would be held to:



"Move at least one initiative from Proposed to Approved by the end of the meeting. If you leave with everything still Proposed, you did not run a QBR, you ran a status update."



A DAY IN THE LIFE



- Preparing QBRs. Our engineers score the technical assessment - you never do, because they know the environment. You take that scored assessment and turn it into the client story: create the Initiatives from the at-risk items, write the budgets, build the roadmap, write the client Goals.

- Running the future-dated comparison assessment. This is the heart of it: today they score 38 percent, and if they approve these four initiatives they score 69 percent by September. That side-by-side is what makes a client say yes. It is yours to own.

- Building the deliverable and picking the right template for the audience. A CEO gets goals, roadmap and budget. An IT director gets technical detail. An office manager wants assets and renewal dates.

- Running the meeting. Presenting live, sending the PDF after, creating the follow-up action items.

- Chasing the initiatives between quarters. This is where most MSPs fail. Approved work that nobody follows up on is worth nothing.

- Getting involved when a client has a problem. Not fixing it yourself - making sure the right person owns it and the client knows where things stand.

- Talking with clients about AI. Every business owner is asking what AI can do for them. You need to hold that conversation credibly - Microsoft 365 Copilot, where AI actually saves a small business time, what governance and acceptable use mean - without pretending to be an engineer.



WHAT WE NEED



- You have worked in or around managed IT services and understand what an MSP does. This is not a role you can learn from scratch.

- You can talk to an American business owner as a peer. Calm, warm, organized, and you follow up when you say you will.

- You are comfortable with numbers - budgets, roadmaps, renewal dates - and you write clean executive-level English.

- You are curious about AI and already use it in your own work.

- ConnectWise, ScalePad Lifecycle Manager, Kaseya or Hudu experience is a real advantage. If you have not used them, you must be quick with new software.



THE HONEST PART



This is client-facing work with American clients, live, on camera. Your spoken English has to be genuinely excellent, not just good written English. We screen for that early because it is the whole job.



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift and it is not flexible, because client meetings happen in US business hours.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work. You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

title: Technical Project Manager (MSP) - ConnectWise, IT Projects - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and we are hiring a Technical Project Manager in the Philippines.



Here is the honest reason this job exists. Over the last 18 months we delivered 63 client projects, and they were managed by five different people who all have other full-time jobs - including the owner. Five projects were cancelled, two went at risk, and nine are sitting in planning waiting for someone to drive them. Nobody owns project management here. That is the seat.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



The projects are real and they repeat. In the last 18 months:



- Microsoft 365 and
 migrations - the single most common project we run

- Workstation and laptop rollouts - ten machines at a time, imaged, configured, delivered

- Server replacements and virtualization

- New client onboarding - taking over an environment from another IT company

- Firewall, WiFi and network upgrades

- Intune and Entra ID rollouts, backup projects, phone system cutovers



Your job is to make those land on time, on budget, and without the client wondering what is happening:



- Take a scoped project and turn it into a real plan: tasks, sequence, hours, who does what, and when.

- Schedule our engineers and keep them unblocked. Chase the dependency nobody noticed - the switch that has not shipped, the license nobody bought, the client contact who has not replied.

- Be the client's single point of contact for the project. They should always know what is next and never have to ask.

- Run it all in ConnectWise Manage on the project board, with time logged against the project so we know whether we made money.

- Catch scope creep early and raise a change order instead of eating the hours.

- Close the project properly: documentation into Hudu, handoff to the service team, and a client who is genuinely happy.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE



You will not manage our CMMC and defense-compliance projects. Those involve controlled government data with strict rules about who may access it, and they stay with our US-based team. We are telling you up front so there is no confusion later.



WHAT WE NEED



- Real project management experience inside an MSP or IT services company. This is the hard requirement. We do not care about PMP, CAPM or Scrum certificates - they are a nice bonus, not a substitute for having actually run IT projects.

- Enough technical literacy to hold a schedule together and know when an estimate is wrong. You do not have to be the engineer. You do have to know what a domain migration involves and roughly how long it should take.

- The organized, slightly stubborn personality that follows up until something is actually done.

- Clear written and spoken English - you will be
ing and talking with American clients.

- ConnectWise Manage experience is a real advantage. Kaseya, Hudu or Microsoft 365 familiarity helps.



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift, and it is not flexible, because you need to be reachable while our engineers and clients are working.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work. You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your opinion on how to do something better



PAY



2,000 to 3,200 USD per month, based on experience and English.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

Project Manager - [Your Name] - [how many projects you are running right now]



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a project that went sideways. What went wrong, what did you do about it, and what did you tell the client?"

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we do this so we do not waste your time or ours on a call that was never going to work.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid exercise: we hand you a real project scope and you build the plan. We pay you for your time.

title: AI Growth Lead - Help Build a New AI Consulting Business - Work From Home
description:
This is not a normal job post. Please read it properly.



I own Crown Computers, a managed IT services company in San Diego, California - 30 years old, 13 people, around 76 business clients. I also own the domain 
, and I am starting an AI consulting business on it. Crown will be its sister company.



I am looking for one person to help me build it from close to zero.



WHAT THE BUSINESS SELLS



Small and mid-sized businesses everywhere are asking the same question: what can AI actually do for us? Most of them have nobody credible to ask. We answer that, and we get paid three ways: a paid AI readiness and risk assessment, ongoing AI governance and management, and building and maintaining the automations themselves.



And because Crown is a 30-year-old IT company, many of those conversations also turn into managed IT work. AI opens the door. IT often walks through it.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



You own getting us in front of San Diego businesses and getting meetings booked. How you do it is largely up to you - I care about booked appointments with real decision makers, not activity reports.



- Build an audience. Instagram, and whatever else you can prove works. Short video, real examples of AI doing something useful for an ordinary business, plain-English explanations that the 55-year-old owner of a plumbing company actually understands.

- Find the businesses worth talking to, and research them properly before we ever reach out.

- Run outreach that does not read like spam. We would rather send thirty genuinely personal messages than three thousand generic ones. That is a rule, not a preference.

- Book the appointments. At the start I take the meetings and you sit in and learn. As you get good, you run more of them.

- Keep the follow-up alive. Most deals are lost because nobody followed up in week three.

- Use AI to do all of this better than a human could alone - research, drafting, personalization, content. If you are not already doing that every day, this is the wrong role.



WHO THIS IS FOR



Someone entrepreneurial who wants to help build something, not be handed a script. If this works, you are running it, and your share grows with it. If you want stable and predictable, take one of our other jobs - we have four others posted right now and they are good jobs.



You should genuinely understand AI. Not as an engineer, but well enough to know what these tools really do and where they fall over, and to explain that to a business owner without jargon and without hype.



You need excellent spoken and written English. You are representing a San Diego company to American business owners.



Marketing, sales development, agency or BPO client-facing backgrounds all fit. GoHighLevel, HubSpot or similar is a plus. So is anything you have personally built an audience for.



THE HONEST PARTS



- This is a night shift. 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM in Manila. American businesses answer the phone during their day, not ours.

- This is early. The website is not finished. There is no big lead list waiting for you. You are helping build it - which is the whole point, and the reason it is interesting.

- We do not automate LinkedIn or scrape people. It violates their terms and gets accounts banned. We build a real audience and send real messages.

- We start with Crown's existing 76 clients, who already trust us, before going cold on strangers. Warm first is not a lack of ambition. It is just what works.

- You need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



PAY



Base of 1,500 to 2,500 USD per month depending on experience, PLUS a real share of the revenue of the business you are helping build. I will not put a percentage in a public job post, but I will tell you the number openly in our conversation and put it in writing. This is meant to be a founding-team arrangement, not a bonus scheme.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

AI Growth - [Your Name] - [a business you think AI could obviously help, and how]



2. Your resume, plus a link to anything you have built an audience for, even a small one. Show me the real numbers, honestly.



3. A voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this out loud and then answering it:

"Pretend I own a 20-person landscaping company in San Diego and I know nothing about AI. In two minutes, convince me to take a meeting with you."

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. For this role, the recording matters more than your resume.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation with me on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid exercise: pick ten real San Diego businesses, tell me why those ten, and write the outreach. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

Creating video ads that generate sales.

?

 and Instagram.

Each product follows proven creative concepts and multiple hooks.



Your job is to understand the system, improve it, and eventually create ads that perform even better than mine.



That’s the goal.



?

I’m not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



I’m looking for someone who understands performance marketing.



Someone who thinks creatively.



Someone who enjoys testing new ideas.



Someone who wants to improve every single week.



I want someone who takes ownership of the creative process instead of waiting for instructions.



?



Skills Required



You should already know how to:



* Create high-converting Meta ads.

* Build strong hooks within the first 3 seconds.

* Create clean, professional subtitles.

* Use motion graphics and motion control naturally.

* Find additional B-roll or stock footage when needed.

* Keep viewers engaged with fast-paced editing.

* Match music and sound effects correctly.

* Create ads for both Norway and Denmark.



?



AI Experience



AI is becoming a huge part of content creation.



Experience with tools like ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Google Veo/Gemini, AI voice cloning, AI subtitles or similar tools is a big advantage.



If AI helps you work faster and create better ads, that’s exactly what I’m looking for.



?



Serious Applicants Only



I’m only interested in serious people.



If you apply, you must provide proof that you know what you’re doing.



Please include:



* Your best Meta/Facebook ad examples.

* Previous eCommerce work (if applicable).

* Portfolio.

* Results, case studies or creatives you’ve worked on.



Applications without previous work or proof of experience will not be considered.



?



Interview Process



Before we begin working together, we’ll have a short video meeting.



I want to get to know you, understand your experience, and make sure we’re a good fit for each other.



Communication and reliability are very important to me.



?



Payment



Starting pay is $3–4 USD per hour, depending on your experience.



If you consistently create great-performing ads, there will be more work, more responsibility and higher pay over time.



?



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell me about yourself.

2. How long have you been editing videos?

3. Have you worked with eCommerce brands before?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which AI tools do you use regularly?

6. Please send your best Meta/Facebook ads.

7. If I gave you one product video, how would you turn it into three completely different ads?

8. How many hours are you available each week?

9. What computer do you use?

10. What is your internet speed?

11. Why should I hire you instead of someone else?



Finally…



At the very top of your application, write the word “FLEXI” so I know you’ve read this entire job post.



I look forward to seeing your application.

title: L3 Network Engineer + AI Automation Specialist (MSP) - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and this is the most unusual role we have ever posted.



We need one person who is genuinely two things: a Level 3 network engineer, and someone who builds AI automation. Most people are one or the other. If you are both, keep reading, because we will pay for that.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Our clients are asking what AI can do for their business, and we are past the point of guessing. We are building an AI practice: we sit down with a client, find the work that is eating their people's hours, and build something that takes it over. Then we manage and govern it every month.



You would be the technical half of that. And because you are also an engineer, you understand the systems the automation has to plug into - which is exactly why hiring two separate people does not work.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



- Sitting in a discovery call with me and a client, asking hard questions about how their business actually runs. Where do people burn hours? What gets copied between systems by hand? You are listening for the thing worth automating.

- Turning that into a real scope: what we build, what it costs one time, and what it costs monthly.

- Then building it. Support bots that answer the repetitive 50 to 60 percent of customer questions. Lead enrichment so a salesperson walks into a call already knowing who they are talking to. Automations that read
, pull data across systems, and take a whole process off a human's plate.

- Wiring AI into things that already exist: Microsoft 365 and Copilot, APIs, databases, ticketing systems.

- Governance: watching what the agents are actually doing, proving nothing strange is happening, and keeping records a client can show an auditor. AI governance is becoming a real standard (ISO 42001) and we intend to be good at it.

- And the engineering half: escalated tickets, Entra ID and Active Directory, firewalls, servers, migrations. You are still an engineer here.



WHAT YOU NEED ON THE AI SIDE



Real, shipped work - not a course certificate. LLM APIs, agents and tool use, RAG, automation platforms, and scripting in Python or PowerShell. If you have built something that is running in production and saving somebody hours every week, that is exactly what we want to hear about.



WHAT YOU NEED ON THE ENGINEERING SIDE



ConnectWise, Kaseya, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V and VMware, Sophos / SonicWall / Ubiquiti firewalls, VPNs, DNS, switching, backups, and Hudu for documentation. You will not know all of it. Know most of it and learn the rest fast.



THE PART MOST ENGINEERS FIND HARDEST



You will be in the room with business owners. You need to explain a technical idea to a non-technical person and make them feel smart, not stupid. You need to hear "we just do it that way" and gently dig until you find out why. Your spoken English has to be very good, because you will be talking, not typing.



If sitting in a client meeting sounds worse than the technical work, this is the wrong role - and the other two jobs we have posted may fit you better.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other. Whoever we add has to fit that:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your technical opinion on how to fix something



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift. Client discovery calls happen during US hours and you need to be in them, so this one is not flexible.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work - we do not sit on a video call all day.



You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



PAY



3,500 to 5,500 USD per month. This is well above our normal engineering range because the combination is rare. If you are genuinely strong at both halves, say so and we will talk.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

AI Engineer - [Your Name] - [the last thing you automated]



2. Your resume, plus a link to or a short description of something you actually built with AI.



3. A voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a time you watched someone doing a repetitive task and worked out how to automate it. How did you explain it to them?"

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we need to hear how you explain things, because that is half of this job.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation with me on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid hands-on exercise on a real automation problem. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Application Google Form Link at the bottom**



Loop Voice builds best-in-class AI voice agents for Shopify brands: agents that recover abandoned



checkouts, win back lapsed customers, confirm orders, and answer the phone at 2 a.m. — and sound so



good doing it that shoppers say “thank you” before they hang up.







We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager to help us make the best brands in ecommerce even better. Not



a ticket-closer. Not a check-in-call scheduler. An owner.







First — why Loop Voice? We asked the team. Here’s what they said.



• “You’re working on the frontier.” AI agents that hold real, natural phone conversations barely



existed two years ago. Here, you don’t read about the future of commerce — you listen to it, live,



every day.



• “The speed is addictive.” A customer insight on Monday is a script change by Wednesday and a



better conversion number by Friday. No committees. No quarterly roadmap theater.



• “You own your work and your hours.” We don’t believe in clocking in and clocking out. This is not a



nine-to-five — it’s a mission you can push as fast and as hard as you’re capable of. The people who



thrive here wouldn’t have it any other way.



• “Your growth compounds.” You’ll build rare, in-demand expertise at the intersection of



conversational AI and ecommerce — years before most people get anywhere near it.



• “Zero corporate nonsense.” Small team, sincere candor, no politics. The best idea wins, even when it



stings.







The role



You’ll own our client relationships end to end — from the first onboarding call through renewal and



expansion — and you’ll be the reason merchants tell their friends about us.







We want a CSM so driven to make customers successful that they take personal pride in every account.





The kind of person who listens to calls the 
nt an agent goes live. Who hears the half-second pause



where a shopper lost interest — and rewrites the script that afternoon. Who tunes the flow, tightens the



follow-up SMS, then refreshes the dashboard to watch the conversion number move. Who knows, in their



bones, what a great phone conversation sounds like: the pacing, the warmth, the exact 
nt to ask for



the sale.







What you’ll actually do:



• Own a portfolio of fast-growing Shopify brands from day one through renewal, expansion, and beyond



• Listen relentlessly: review call recordings the 
nt agents go live, catch where they underperform, and fix it fast



• Optimize scripts, conversation flows, and follow-ups hand in hand with our team — then prove the lift with data



• Spot patterns across accounts: if a certain type of call keeps going sideways, you see it first and you kill it



• Be the voice of the customer inside Loop Voice, turning what you hear into product improvements that actually ship



• Help write our customer success playbook itself — you’re early, and the way we do CS will carry your fingerprints







What winning looks like



No vague stuff. You’ll know you’re succeeding when:



• Your brands go live in days, not weeks — and see results inside their first month



• Agent performance climbs month over month on your accounts — more calls connected, more checkouts recovered, fewer drop-offs — because you kept turning the screws



• Renewals feel like formalities, because the value has been obvious all year



• Expansion comes fro
rchants asking for more — not from you pushing



• The product roadmap visibly carries the evidence you brought in



• Merchants name-drop you when they refer other brands to us







Who we’re looking for



• Proven SaaS customer success experience with SME to mid-market accounts — you’ve owned a book of business, carried renewal and expansion goals, and hit them



• Hands-on experience working with Shopify stores — you speak fluent merchant: AOV, LTV, abandoned checkout, repeat rate



• A sharp, trained ear for conversation — you can tell exactly why a call worked or didn’t, and put it into words



• Comfort deep in call data — transcripts, connection rates, conversion funnels — and confidence drawing conclusions from it



• High energy and competitive greatness — you play to win, and you hate losing an account more than almost anything



• Sincere candor — you say the true thing, kindly and fast, to customers and teammates alike



• A self-starter who doesn’t need heavy oversight — you see what needs doing, and you do it







Bonus points for:



• Background in voice, call-center QA, or conversational AI



• Experience with CRM or customer success platforms



• A track record of influencing product roadmap with customer evidence







Where and how we work



We’re remote today. Early next year we’re opening our office in the Los Angeles area and building an in-person team there — we believe the best companies are built shoulder to shoulder. You should be in LA, or excited to get there.







And how we work: fast. Bold ideas, and the freedom to execute them — that’s our formula. We don’t measure hours; we measure outcomes. If you want a place to hide, this isn’t it. If you want a place to run, welcome home.







The sound of what’s next



This position will be filled immediately for the right candidate — we move at the same speed we expect from you.







If you read this and felt your pulse pick up: apply now, and tell us about a customer you made wildly successful — and exactly how you did it.







And if this role isn’t for you but you know the person it was written for — send it to them. They’ll thank you.
