title: Senior U.S. Accountant & Financial Analyst (CPA)
description:
Required Qualifications



Master’s degree in Accounting

CPA License

At least 10 years of professional accounting, financial-analysis, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

At least five years of experience working directly with U.S.-based businesses or U.S. accounting firms.

Significant hands-on experience with complex bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects.

Experience reviewing the bookkeeping work of other accountants or bookkeepers.

Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, adjusting journal entries, and financial-statement preparation.

Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

Strong QuickBooks Desktop and Xero experience.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience analyzing large accounting datasets.

Experience creating budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, and financial models.

Ability to analyze business performance and provide meaningful financial recommendations.

Strong understanding of balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.

Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong professional judgment, critical-thinking ability, and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate complex accounting and financial information clearly.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet connection, and backup power solution.

Willingness to follow strict confidentiality, cybersecurity, and data-protection procedures.

Be able to work US Eastern Standard Time schedule

Must provide NBI Clearance







We are a U.S.-based accounting and advisory firm looking for an exceptionally strong Senior Accountant and Financial Analyst.



This person will be responsible for complex bookkeeping cleanups, reviewing bookkeeping completed by other tea
mbers, preparing accurate financial statements, analyzing accounting data, and helping business owners understand what their financial information means.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or transaction-categorization position. We need someone who can independently handle the accounting records of multi-million-dollar companies, identify serious bookkeeping and financial-reporting problems, correct the records, analyze business performance, and provide meaningful financial recommendations.



The ideal candidate must be highly proficient in U.S. GAAP, QuickBooks, Xero, Microsoft Excel, accounting-data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow analysis, and management reporting.



Primary Responsibilities



Accounting Cleanup and Review



Review existing bookkeeping for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with U.S. GAAP.

Perform complex QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, and accounting-system cleanups.

Review bookkeeping completed by other accountants and bookkeepers.

Analyze the general ledger, trial balance, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and supporting schedules.

Identify incorrect classifications, duplicate transactions, missing transactions, unsupported balances, and reconciliation problems.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant processors, payroll accounts, clearing accounts, and intercompany balances.

Correct accounts receivable and accounts payable discrepancies.

Review and correct undeposited funds, suspense accounts, opening balance equity, retained earnings, owner equity, and uncategorized transactions.

Review payroll expenses, payroll liabilities, sales-tax liabilities, loan balances, fixed assets, accumulated depreciation, prepaid expenses, deferred revenue, accruals, and other balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare and post adjusting journal entries.

Manage month-end and year-end closing procedures.

Maintain supporting schedules, reconciliation workpapers, cleanup logs, and complete audit trails.



Excel and Accounting Data Analysis



Use advanced Microsoft Excel to organize, clean, analyze, and reconcile large accounting datasets.

Combine data from QuickBooks, Xero, banks, payroll systems, merchant processors, and other platforms.

Analyze general-ledger and transaction-level data to identify errors, duplicates, unusual activity, missing information, and financial trends.

Use PivotTables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, IF formulas, dynamic arrays, data validation, conditional formatting, and other advanced Excel functions.

Build repeatable Excel models and templates for accounting reconciliations and financial analysis.

Perform data cleanup, account mapping, transaction matching, variance analysis, and trend analysis.

Create dashboards, charts, schedules, and management reports that clearly explain financial performance.

Validate the completeness and accuracy of imported or exported accounting data.

Work efficiently with large data files containing thousands of transactions.



Budgeting and Forecasting



Prepare annual operating budgets based on historical results and management assumptions.

Create monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts.

Develop rolling 12-month forecasts.

Prepare revenue, expense, payroll, capital-expenditure, and working-capital projections.

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

Investigate and explain significant budget-to-actual variances.

Update forecasts based on current financial performance and changing business conditions.

Build scenario models showing best-case, expected-case, and worst-case results.

Help management understand the financial impact of hiring, pricing, expansion, financing, and other business decisions.



Cash-Flow Analysis



Prepare direct and indirect cash-flow analyses.

Develop weekly and monthly cash-flow forecasts.

Create rolling 13-week cash-flow models.

Analyze expected customer collections, vendor payments, payroll obligations, loan payments, taxes, and other cash requirements.

Identify potential cash shortages before they occur.

Analyze working-capital trends, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and operating cash requirements.

Recommend ways to improve cash flow, collections, payment timing, and working-capital management.

Monitor actual cash activity against forecasted cash flow and explain major differences.



Financial Reporting and Business Recommendations



Prepare accurate balance sheets, income statements, cash-flow statements, and management reports.

Develop monthly financial-reporting packages for business owners and management.

Analyze revenue growth, gross profit, operating expenses, margins, customer concentration, and profitability.

Identify unusual financial trends, declining margins, increasing costs, or potential operational problems.

Calculate and analyze financial and operational key performance indicators.

Review profitability by customer, product, location, department, class, or service line.

Translate bookkeeping information into clear business insights.

Make practical recommendations based on financial results.

Identify areas where the company may be overspending, underpricing, losing money, or using cash inefficiently.

Recommend improvements to accounting procedures, internal controls, reporting, and financial management.

Clearly explain financial information to business owners who may not have an accounting background.



Required Qualifications



Master’s degree in Accounting

CPA License

At least 10 years of professional accounting, financial-analysis, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

At least five years of experience working directly with U.S.-based businesses or U.S. accounting firms.

Significant hands-on experience with complex bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects.

Experience reviewing the bookkeeping work of other accountants or bookkeepers.

Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, adjusting journal entries, and financial-statement preparation.

Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

Strong QuickBooks Desktop and Xero experience.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience analyzing large accounting datasets.

Experience creating budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, and financial models.

Ability to analyze business performance and provide meaningful financial recommendations.

Strong understanding of balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.

Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong professional judgment, critical-thinking ability, and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate complex accounting and financial information clearly.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet connection, and backup power solution.

Willingness to follow strict confidentiality, cybersecurity, and data-protection procedures.

Be able to work US Eastern Standard Time schedule





What Success Looks Like



A successful candidate will be able to:



Take over disorganized books and determine what is wrong without requiring step-by-step instructions.

Develop and execute a complete accounting-cleanup plan.

Produce reconciled and properly supported balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare a reliable trial balance and accurate financial statements.

Review another bookkeeper’s work and identify errors that others may overlook.

Analyze large accounting datasets efficiently using Excel.

Build a usable budget, forecast, and cash-flow model from historical bookkeeping data.

Explain why actual results differ from the budget or forecast.

Identify meaningful trends and risks from the company’s financial information.

Provide practical recommendations that help business owners improve profitability, cash flow, and financial controls.

Communicate findings clearly through workpapers, reports,
s, and meetings.





Compensation and Benefits

PHP 100,000–140,000 per month, based on experience and demonstrated ability.

Salary paid twice per month.

13th-month-equivalent bonus after completing the applicable service period.

Paid time off after the probationary period.

Performance-based salary reviews and bonuses.

Long-term and stable employment.

Opportunity to grow into an accounting-manager, financial-analysis, or fractional CFO support role.

Direct exposure to complex U.S. companies and advanced accounting and advisory projects.





How to Apply



Begin your application subject line with:



SENIOR ACCOUNTING ANALYST – [Your Full Name]



Submit the following:



Your resume.

A link to your LinkedIn profile, if available.

Copies or links to your accounting, QuickBooks, Xero, Excel, or financial-analysis certifications.

A short video of no more than four minutes explaining:

The most complicated accounting cleanup you have completed

A budget, forecast, or cash-flow model you have prepared

A business recommendation you made based on accounting data

An example of an accounting workpaper, reconciliation, financial model, dashboard, or management report that you personally prepared. 

Complete answers to all application questions.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or provide complete answers will not be considered.





Application Questions



Please number your answers.



How many total years of accounting and bookkeeping experience do you have?

How many years have you worked directly with U.S.-based businesses or U.S. accounting firms?

Describe the most complicated bookkeeping cleanup you personally completed. Include:

Approximate annual revenue

Accounting platform

Condition of the books

Major problems identified

How you investigated and corrected them

Final result



What is the largest company, based on revenue or transaction volume, whose accounting you personally handled?

Describe your process for reviewing bookkeeping completed by another accountant.

Describe the most advanced Excel accounting model you have personally built.

Explain your process for preparing an annual operating budget.

Rate your ability from 1 to 10 in each area and briefly explain each rating:

QuickBooks Online

QuickBooks Desktop

Xero

Microsoft Excel

Accounting data analysis

Accrual accounting

U.S. GAAP

Bookkeeping cleanup

Financial-statement review

Budgeting

Forecasting

Cash-flow analysis

Financial modeling

Business recommendations

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines |$700-$1200 per month  + 13th month pay depending on skills



About Us

We’re Field Days — one of Australia’s biggest outdoor/fishing YouTube brands, with 4M+ subscribers and followers across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and
, a members-only streaming platform, and a merchandise store. We publish high-volume video content every week and we’re scaling our editing team.



This is a full-time seat on our creative team, working under our Marketing Manager with creative direction from our Design Lead. Your cuts will be seen by millions of people.



The Role

You’ll turn our long-form YouTube content and raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form video, and help cut long-form episodes as you grow with us:



Cut short-form reels daily for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and
 — each one built around a hook in the first 2 seconds



Repurpose long-form YouTube episodes into multiple shorts per episode



Edit with retention in mind: pacing, cuts every few seconds, captions, sound design, pattern interrupts you know why people stop scrolling and you edit for it



Work with project management softwares



Take feedback fast: our leads review for craft, you revise same-day



Adapt edits per platform what works on TikTok is not what works on Instagram, and you know the difference

Assist on long-form YouTube edits as capacity allows



You Must Have

4+ years editing short-form content for real brands or creators (show us links)

Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci at professional speed

Proven understanding of hooks, retention editing and platform-native style

Strong captioning/typography and sound design fundamentals

Comfortable using AI tools to move faster (auto-captions, cutdowns, workflow tools)

Reliable internet, fast turnaround, and availability across Australian business hours (approx. 7:00am–4:00pm Philippine time)

Bonus: outdoor/fishing/adventure content experience, thumbnail design, After Effects motion graphics



HOW TO APPLY READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS THE INTERVIEW

We don’t shortlist from resumes. We shortlist from edits.



Your application task:

Go to our YouTube channel and pick any published Field Days video you like.



Cut TWO original short-form reels from it (30–60 seconds, 9:16 vertical, captioned):



Reel 1 — made for TikTok: raw, fast, native TikTok energy. Hook in the first 2 seconds or it’s a scroll-past.

Reel 2 — made for Instagram Reels: cleaner, more polished feel, still hook-first.



Upload both to Google Drive (make sure link sharing is ON “anyone with the link can view”).



Send your application starting with the word REELS, containing:

Your Google Drive link with both edits



2–3 sentences: which video you chose and why you built each hook the way you did



Links to short-form work you’ve done for other brands/creators



Your earliest start date



What we’re judging: the hook, the pacing, the captions, and whether each edit actually feels native to its platform. If we like your edits, we’ll contact you for an interview and a paid trial week.



Applications without the REELS keyword or the two edits will not be reviewed. Please don’t send generic showreels instead of the task the task IS the application.



Note: application edits may be used for our audience to see the reach of the reel or if the audience like it.

title: Senior UI/UX & Motion Designer
description:
Senior UI/UX & Motion Designer (SaaS AI Products) — Remote, Full-Time



Job Summary



Aureate Labs is looking for a Senior UI/UX & Motion Designer to own the design of our SaaS AI products end-to-end — from Figma screens and design systems through to promotional and explainer videos that show our products to the world. This is a long-term, full-time remote role working directly with our founder and development team across multiple active products. Do well here and there is a genuine growth path, including the possibility of an in-office role with us in the future.



About Us



Aureate Enterprise T/A Aureate Labs builds SaaS products powered by AI. We're a small, fast-moving team with multiple products in active development — which means your work ships quickly, your designs get used by real customers, and you'll never be a small cog in a big machine. You'll be our go-to design person across product and marketing.



What You'll Do:



Product Design (primary — roughly 70%)



-Design clean, modern UI for our SaaS web applications in Figma — dashboards, onboarding flows, forms, settings, data-heavy screens



-Build and maintain a reusable component library / design system so our products stay consistent as they grow



-Turn rough briefs and feature ideas into wireframes, then high-fidelity designs ready for developer handoff



-Work directly with our developer — organized Figma files, auto-layout, clear specs and annotations



-Iterate based on feedback, user behavior, and product priorities



Motion & Video (secondary — roughly 30%)



-Create promotional videos for social media (short-form, product highlights, feature announcements)



-Produce SaaS explainer videos — animated product walkthroughs with motion graphics (After Effects or similar; 2.5D style)



-Design supporting marketing creative: ad graphics, landing page visuals, social media assets



Requirements

Must have:



-5+ years of UI/UX design experience, with real SaaS / web app product work in your portfolio (not just landing pages or graphics)



-Expert-level Figma — components, auto-layout, prototyping, developer handoff



-Motion graphics / video editing skills — After Effects, Premiere, or equivalent, with examples we can watch



-A portfolio and/or showreel you can share (Figma, Behance, Dribbble, YouTube, Vimeo, or personal site)



-Strong English communication — you'll work directly with the founder and dev team



-Full-time availability (8 hours/day) and reliable internet with backup





Nice to have:



-Experience designing AI product interfaces (chat UIs, AI assistants, automation tools)



-3D or 2.5D explainer video experience (Blender, Cinema 4D, Spline)



-Basic understanding of HTML/CSS so your designs are practical to build



-Experience with AI design/video tools (Runway, Midjourney, etc.)



-Familiarity working alongside AI-assisted development workflows





What We Offer



PHP60,000 – PHP100,000+/month, depending on experience — and we're happy to go beyond this range for an exceptional candidate, so don't self-select out if you're above it



-13th month pay



-Paid time off + paid sick days



-Long-term, stable full-time role — we're building products, not running a one-off project



-Work directly with the founder — your ideas actually shape the product



-Variety: product UI one week, launch video the next — never repetitive



-Growth path as Aureate Labs expands, including the possibility of transitioning to an in-office role in the future for the right person





How to Apply:



Apply with your updated resume and include:



-Your portfolio link showing SaaS/app UI work



-Your updated resume/CV



-Your video/motion reel (or links to 2–3 videos you've made)





Applications without a portfolio and reel will not be considered — for this role, your work speaks louder than your resume.



To confirm you've read this post, start your application with the word "GOLDEN." Applications without it won't be reviewed.

title: Outbound Cold Caller and Sales Closer with 2+ years experience
description:
Work hours: US business hours 



Setup: Onsite for the first month, potential hybrid setup after depending on performance



Salary: 35,000 - 50,000







We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Sales Closer to support a growing US-based business that provides professional services to real estate agents and brokerages.



The right candidate is a confident communicator and relationship builder who can serve as the driving force behind our lead generation and sales efforts, ensuring prospects are highly qualified, objections are handled confidently, and opportunities are seamlessly converted into booked appointments and closed sales.



We prefer someone who lives near Alabang, Muntinlupa and can readily meet the onsite requirement for at least the first month.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Outbound Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients using provided lead lists to introduce services, generate organic interest, and identify key decision-makers.



Lead Qualification: Qualify prospects based on established criteria, accurately document detailed conversations, and maintain organized records of all interactions.



Appointment Setting: Schedule discovery calls, consultations, and sales appointments, confirming schedules and coordinating with internal team members for a smooth handoff.



Sales Support: Play an integral role in moving prospects through the sales pipeline. Build strong rapport and establish trust with prospects, handle objections confidently, and follow approved sales processes and scripts while adapting naturally to conversations. 



CRM Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within the CRM, meticulously updating lead statuses, pipeline notes, follow-up schedules, and daily sales activities, ensuring all prospect information is properly documented.



Performance Reporting: Track daily outreach activity, conversations, and appointments generated to consistently meet established performance and activity goals.







QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: At least 2 years of experience in cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, inside sales, or business development. Experience selling services or working in a B2B environment is highly preferred.



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. Must possess strong rapport-building, active listening, and objection-handling abilities, and feel comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers.



Sales Skills: Proven ability to generate appointments and sales opportunities through outbound prospecting, backed by strong persuasive closing skills and a goal-oriented mindset.



Tech Savvy: Proficiency with CRM systems, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office. Experience utilizing dialing platforms and sales engagement tools is a major plus.



Attributes: Someone who loves challenges and is passionate about getting results. Self-motivated, highly accountable, resilient when handling rejection, organized, detail-oriented, and fully capable of working with minimal supervision. 



BPO Background: Prior experience working in high-stakes sales, retention, collections, lead generation, or outbound customer service accounts is a major advantage.







Close proximity to our office in Alabang, Muntinlupa is preferred. 



Whie we offer a hybrid work model, the first month requires a “boots on the ground” start at our Alabang office to ensure proper onboarding and alignment. Once you’ve mastered the workflows and hit your initial performance milestones, you can be eligible for a hybrid setup.

title: Appointment Setter | Full Time | Remote Nested Housing | Short Term Rental Co-Hosting
description:
This Role Is Not For Everyone. It Is For One Person.



That person wakes up with something to prove. They do not need to be managed. They are not looking for a comfortable job. They are looking for a launchpad, a team that will invest in them the same way they invest in themselves, and a role where their effort directly shapes the trajectory of a growing company.



If that is you, keep reading.



What We Do:

Nested Housing is a co-hosting and short term rental company built on one non-negotiable: every person who interacts with us leaves better than when they arrived. Whether they become a client or not. That is the standard we hold ourselves to every single day.



We are not a big corporate team. We are a tight group of people who care deeply about each other, about the people we serve, and about the long term vision we are building together. We invest in our people the way we invest in our business, because the people are the business.



The Role and Why It Matters:

Right now, qualified prospects are coming in and not getting the attention they deserve. Cold leads are sitting untouched. Follow ups are being missed. Appointments are not being booked fast enough for our closing team.



You are the person who fixes that.



As our Appointment Setter, you are the first voice and the first relationship a prospect has with Nested Housing. When you perform at the highest level, our closers close, our business scales, and our mission reaches more people. This role is the engine of our entire revenue operation. It is not small, and we will not treat it that way.



What winning looks like in this role:

Qualified appointments are consistently booked for our closing team. Leads are nurtured with genuine care, not a script. Every prospect interaction reflects the standard of Nested Housing, value first, always. Outcomes are tracked, patterns are identified, and you bring insights back to the team without being asked.



The Daily Reality:

This is a full time role. It is your only job. We are not your side hustle and you are not ours.



Your day runs from 8AM to 5PM EST. Within that window you will be doing high volume outbound outreach across multiple channels, vetting and qualifying leads, booking appointments, updating our Google Sheets and Notion pipeline, attending team calls and accountability sessions, and submitting your end of day and end of week reports without exception.



There is no version of this role where you coast. There is a version where you grow faster than you thought possible.



Who This Is Actually For:

You do not need years of experience in appointment setting. You do need the following, and there is no substitute for any of it:



You have a long term vision for yourself and you are actively working toward it. You hold yourself accountable before anyone else has to. When something goes wrong, you look inward first. You are deeply coachable, not because you are passive, but because you understand that learning faster is how you win. You thrive in a team environment and genuinely want to see the people around you succeed. You are the kind of person who reads the entire job description.



To confirm you did, include the phrase "I build, I grow" somewhere in your application.



You are growth-oriented, proactive, and you bring energy to the work even on the days it is hard. You are honest, even when the truth is uncomfortable. You would never sell someone on something you do not genuinely believe will help them.



This Is Not For You If:

You are looking for something flexible to fit around other commitments. You externalize blame when results are not there. You need to be pushed to do the basics. Your words and your actions do not match.



Where This Goes:

We promote from within.



The path is real: Setter, Lead Setter, Closer, Acquisitions Manager.



What we are building is not a temporary business. The culture, the relationships, and the experiences you gain here will have a long term impact on who you become, not just what you earn.



Compensation is performance-based and tiered. The better you perform, the more you earn. Full details are discussed during the interview process.



Ready to Apply?

Submit your application here: tally.so/r/NpExWQ



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Low effort responses will not be reviewed. If your application is vague, surface level, or shorter than the care this opportunity deserves, it will not move forward.

The ideal candidate has experience working as a call-center team leader, supervisor, operations manager, workforce manager, or quality-assurance manager. You should be comfortable creating systems where few currently exist and taking ownership of projects without needing constant supervision.



During the initial stage, you may also assist with calls, client support, recruitment, training, and daily administrative tasks. As the company grows, this position may develop into a senior operations-management role overseeing agents and team leaders.



Key Responsibilities:



 Build Our Operational Foundation:

* Create standard operating procedures for daily call-center operations

* Develop agent handbooks, workplace policies, and internal guidelines

* Create call scripts,
 templates, escalation procedures, and customer-service standards

* Establish opening, closing, attendance, scheduling, and shift-handover procedures

* Help select and organize the tools needed to manage agents, calls, clients, and performance

* Create systems that can be repeated as new clients and employees are added



Recruitment and Training:

* Help develop job descriptions and candidate-screening procedures

* Review applications and conduct initial candidate interviews

* Create onboarding checklists and new-hire training programs

* Develop training materials, quizzes, role-playing exercises, and call simulations

* Coach agents on professionalism, communication, customer service, sales, and call handling

* Maintain organized employee and training records



 Call-Center Management:

* Support and supervise call-center agents

* Monitor attendance, punctuality, productivity, and schedule adherence

* Review calls and provide structured coaching and feedback

* Handle customer escalations and difficult situations professionally

* Ensure agents follow client instructions, scripts, and company policies

* Assist with workforce scheduling and coverage planning

* Conduct regular individual and team performance meetings



Quality Assurance and Reporting:

* Develop call-monitoring and quality-assurance scorecards

* Create key performance indicators for agents and teams

* Track metrics such as call volume, response time, conversion rate, customer satisfaction, attendance, and quality scores

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports

* Identify recurring problems and recommend practical solutions

Client and Business Support:

* Translate client expectations into clear instructions for agents

* Participate in client meetings when needed

* Maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, and employee information

* Support the founder with operational projects and business-growth initiatives



Required Qualifications:

* At least 3 years of experience in a call center, BPO, customer-service, or outsourced operations environment

* Previous experience as a team leader, supervisor, trainer, quality analyst, workforce coordinator, or operations manager

* Strong spoken and written English

* Experience creating SOPs, training materials, reports, and internal processes

* Experience managing or coaching remote employees

* Strong knowledge of call-center performance metrics and quality assurance

* Excellent organizational, leadership, and problem-solving skills

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

* Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes are still being developed

: Preferred Qualifications: The following experience is helpful but not required:

* Experience supporting US- or UK-based clients

* Experience with CRM systems, cloud phone platforms, project-management tools, and workforce-management software

* Experience with inbound customer service, outbound calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or sales

* Experience creating dashboards and reports using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

* Experience developing performance-improvement plans and incentive programs

* Experience with recruitment, human resources, or employee relations



Who Will Succeed in This Role? You may be a strong fit if you:

* Are a builder who enjoys creating structure and improving processes

* Can identify what needs to be done without waiting for detailed instructions

* Communicate clearly and professionally

* Are comfortable switching between strategy and hands-on work

title: Customer Support VA
description:
About XANS



XANS is a growing online clothing brand looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Customer Support Virtual Assistant to manage our Instagram DMs and Gmail customer-support inbox.



This is a long-term position for someone who writes clearly, communicates professionally, understands streetwear customers, and can handle customer service, sizing questions, promotional inquiries, and collaboration requests.



Main Responsibilities



• Respond to customer inquiries through Instagram DMs and Gmail

• Answer questions about products, sizing, fit, shipping, tracking, orders, discount codes, and product availability

• Recommend clothing sizes based on the customer’s height, weight, and preferred fit

• Check Shopify and carrier tracking before providing order updates

• Respond to promotional, modeling, influencer, and collaboration inquiries

• Collect relevant information from creators, including their social media username, follower count, average views, location, clothing size, and requested collaboration

• Use our approved templates while making each response sound natural and personal

• Direct customers to the XANS website and mention that we ship worldwide when relevant

• Assist with incomplete addresses, delayed shipments, delivery problems, and tracking concerns

• Organize conversations that require follow-up

• Escalate complicated or sensitive situations to the owner

• Send an end-of-shift report covering unresolved cases, refund requests, delivery issues, and promising collaboration opportunities



Important Rules



• Never approve a refund, return, cancellation, exchange, replacement, or free product without permission

• Never promise a creator a free item, paid promotion, modeling position, or collaboration without approval

• Never provide an unauthorized discount code

• Never promise an exact delivery date unless it has been confirmed

• Always verify order and tracking information before responding

• Never argue with, insult, threaten, or disrespect a customer

• Never admit that XANS made a mistake without first verifying the situation

• Keep all customer and creator conversations professional and business-related

• Do not move customers or creators to a personal account

• Escalate legal threats, chargebacks, fraud concerns, harassment, and serious complaints immediately

• Keep all customer and business information private and confidential



Requirements



• Strong written English, grammar, and reading comprehension

• Previous customer-support or e-commerce experience

• Experience using Instagram, Gmail, Shopify, and order-tracking websites is preferred

• Experience handling influencer, promotional, or collaboration inquiries is a plus

• Basic understanding of clothing sizing and oversized streetwear fits

• Able to communicate in a friendly, casual, and professional tone

• Detail-oriented and able to follow written policies and templates

• Able to remain calm when handling upset customers

• Reliable computer and stable internet connection

• Able to work independently while knowing when approval is required

• Available to work consistent hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time



Compensation



• $3–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Opportunity for a raise based on accuracy, reliability, communication, and long-term performance



How to Apply



Please submit a proper and updated professional resume in PDF format. Your resume should clearly include your previous employment, customer-support experience, relevant skills, software experience, education, and contact information.



Your application must also include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Your previous customer-support or e-commerce experience

3. The platforms you have used, including Instagram, Gmail, Shopify, or similar tools

4. Your available working hours in U.S. Central Time

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

7. The words “XANS SUPPORT” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire post



Please answer all three situations below:



Situation 1:



A customer says:



“My tracking has not updated in seven days, and I want a refund right now.”



Write the exact response you would send to the customer.



Situation 2:



A creator says:



“I love your brand. Can you send me free clothes so I can promote you?”



Write the exact response you would send to the creator.



Situation 3:



A customer asks:



“What size should I wear if I’m 5’7” and 160 lbs?”



Write the exact response you would send. Make sure you explain the difference between the recommended regular fit and a more oversized fit.



Applications without a proper resume or answers to all three situations will not be considered. Please do not use AI-generated answers.

title: Sales Support & CRM Administrator (Pipedrive + Xero)
description:
About us



We are The Stonemen, a natural stone supplier based in Brisbane, Australia. We sell marble, travertine and limestone to builders, landscapers and renovators. We are a small team and we are growing.



Australia is only two hours ahead of the Philippines, so you will be working the same hours as us, not overnight.



The role in one sentence



You will get our Pipedrive CRM set up properly, then run the quoting, invoicing and follow-up work inside it — so that our salespeople can spend their time selling instead of doing paperwork.



This is a real, long-term role. It is not a short project.



Your first few weeks: getting Pipedrive right



This part is critical to us, and it is why we want someone with real CRM experience rather than a general admin assistant.



We have started building our Pipedrive ourselves. It works, but we are not CRM experts and we know some of it is wrong. Before we bring our sales team on and import our customer list, we want someone who has done this before to go through it properly.



You will:



Audit what we have built — our pipelines, stages, custom fields, automations, filters, reports and user permissions — and tell us plainly what is wrong, missing or going to cause problems later

Fix it, once we have agreed the changes

Import our data — our full customer list, our product list, and our open quotes — cleanly and without duplicates

Build simple training material for our sales team, in plain English. None of them have used a CRM before, so clear beats clever

Set up the reports our management team needs to review the sales pipeline each week



We want your opinion here, not just your hands. If we have designed something badly, say so. We would much rather hear it now than in six months.



What you will do day to day, after that



Quotes



Take job details from our salespeople and build the quote in Pipedrive (our CRM)

Check the stock and pricing information we give you, and ask when something does not look right

Send the quote out through Xero (our accounting system)

Record the date it was sent and schedule the follow-ups



Follow-up



Send follow-up
s to customers on a set schedule

Remind our salespeople when they owe a customer a phone call

Keep the record of what has happened on every job up to date



Invoices



Raise invoices in Xero once a sale is confirmed

Follow up customers who have not paid



Purchase orders



Prepare purchase orders to our Australian suppliers, for approval before they are sent

(Overseas orders are handled by our team in Australia, not by you)



Keeping the CRM clean



Make sure every deal has the information it needs: a contact person, a value, a decision date and a next step

Chase our salespeople when something is missing

Flag jobs that have gone quiet



Improving the system over time



Keep improving how Pipedrive is set up as we learn what works and what does not

Build automations that remove repetitive manual steps, once a process has settled down and proven itself

Suggest better ways of doing things — we expect the setup in month twelve to look different from month one



Later on, once you are settled, the role may grow to include other administrative support for our business. We will talk about that when we get there.



To be clear about what this role is not: we are not looking for someone to manage calendars or
 inboxes, and this is not a lead generation, cold calling or social media role.



What we need from you



Essential



You have set up or reconfigured a CRM before, not only used one. Pipedrive is ideal, but HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar is fine. Tell us what you built and what decisions you made

Experience importing and cleaning data — customer lists, product lists, duplicates

Experience creating quotes or invoices in an accounting system. Xero is ideal, but QuickBooks, MYOB or similar is fine

Very good written English — you will be
ing our Australian customers directly

Strong attention to detail. Our quotes contain prices, quantities and measurements, and a small mistake costs us real money

Comfortable working through the same list of tasks every day and not letting anything slip

Reliable internet and a quiet place to work



Nice to have



Experience working with an Australian business

Experience in construction, building supplies, or a product-based business

Understanding of purchase orders and stock



Most important of all: we need someone who tells us when something looks wrong instead of guessing. If a price does not match, or a customer's request does not make sense, we want you to ask. We will never be annoyed at you for asking.



What we offer

- A clear, well-documented process — you will not be left to figure it out alone

- Direct working relationship with the business owner, not layers of management

- Long-term, stable work with a growing company

- Regular hours that match your own timezone

- Training on our systems in your first weeks

- How to apply



Please send us a message that includes:



- Start your message with the word TRAVERTINE so we know you read the whole ad.

- Which CRM you have used, and for how long. If you have set one up or reconfigured one, describe what you built and one decision you made that you think was a good one.

- Which accounting system you have used to create quotes or invoices, and roughly how many you would produce in a typical week.

- A short description of a time you spotted a mistake in someone else's work before it went out to a customer.

- Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Applications that do not follow these steps will not be read.



We will reply to shortlisted applicants within 10 days. There will be a short paid test task before we make any offer, we would rather see your work than guess from a CV.



Thank you for reading, and we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Audio Visual Estimator
description:
About MNGD



MNGD is an Australian-owned agile business that specialises in providing innovative and next generation workplace technology solutions. With our expertise grounded in industry-leading hardware and software solutions, we pride ourselves on delivering tomorrows technology, today.



With our client-centric focus, we deliver video conferencing, unified communications solutions (Teams and Zoom), boardrooms, meeting rooms, teaching and collaborative spaces, video walls, network based audio visual solutions and we guide and manage the process of converting isolated AV systems to full integration with clients IT networks.





The Role



We are currently seeking a highly skilled and experienced Full-Time Estimator to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a  background in the AV industry, with knowledge in systems and technologies such as Crestron, QSC, and other unified communication systems. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the success of our projects by providing accurate and comprehensive estimates for AV installations and integrations.







Responsibilities



Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and sales team members to gather project requirements and specifications.

Conduct thorough assessments of project scope, including equipment needs, labor requirements, and project timelines.

Utilise industry-specific software and tools to generate detailed cost estimates for AV installations and integrations.

Research and evaluate new technologies, products, and suppliers to ensure competitiveness and innovation in our estimates.

Communicate effectively with clients to present and explain estimates, address any questions or concerns, and negotiate terms as needed.

Maintain organized records of project estimates, including revisions and updates as projects progress.





Skills and Experience



Previous experience in the Audio Visual industry, with a focus on estimating or project management.

In-depth knowledge of AV systems and technologies, including Crestron & QSC.

Proficiency in industry-specific software and tools for estimating, such as Microsoft Excel, AV-specific software, and ERP systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to accurately assess project requirements and develop detailed estimates.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Detail-oriented and highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Flexibility to work part-time hours, with the potential for increased hours during peak periods or project deadlines.
